jobs.title: Landscape Account Manager
jobs.description:
**SGD Enterprises dba Four Seasons Landscaping** is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and hands\-on **Landscape Contract Project Manager** to oversee one of our largest and most complex municipal landscape maintenance contracts in the City of Irvine.

This is a high\-level operational position responsible for the **overall performance, staffing, quality control, reporting, and day\-to\-day execution of the contract**. The Project Manager will serve as the central point of accountability for the project and will work closely with company leadership, field supervisors, irrigation personnel, specialty crews, and City representatives to ensure that all contractual requirements are performed consistently, timely, safely, and to the exceptionally high standards expected by the City of Irvine.

This is **not simply an administrative project\-management position**. The successful candidate must have extensive practical knowledge of commercial landscape maintenance and be capable of walking a property, identifying deficiencies, understanding the appropriate corrective action, directing crews, and verifying that the work has been completed correctly.

Position Overview

The City of Irvine contract encompasses a large portfolio of parks and athletic facilities with extensive turf, athletic fields, landscaped planter areas, irrigation systems, environmental services, specialized turf\-management operations, fertilization, pest management, renovation work, and other technical landscape requirements.

Because of the **size, complexity, visibility, and performance expectations of this contract**, we are looking for a Project Manager who understands landscape maintenance at a professional level and can successfully manage both the people and the technical requirements necessary to deliver an exceptional product.

The ideal candidate will be someone who takes ownership of the project, anticipates problems before they become issues, maintains excellent communication with the City, and holds crews and supervisors accountable for consistently meeting contract specifications.

Key Responsibilities

* Assume overall responsibility for the **successful performance of the City of Irvine landscape maintenance contract**.
* Manage and oversee a large workforce consisting of mowing crews, landscape/detail crews, environmental crews, irrigation technicians, IPM personnel, athletic\-field personnel, supervisors, and specialty turf\-renovation crews.
* Develop and maintain weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual work schedules to ensure that **every contractual requirement is completed within the required service frequency and timeframe**.
* Conduct frequent field inspections throughout the City to evaluate landscape quality, turf conditions, athletic fields, planter areas, irrigation performance, cleanliness, and overall contract compliance.
* Ensure that mowing, edging, detailing, pruning, fertilization, aeration, overseeding, topdressing, turf renovation, irrigation maintenance, pest\-management operations, and other specialized landscape activities are performed correctly.
* Coordinate equipment, vehicles, materials, crews, and subcontractors so work is completed efficiently and without interruption.
* Work directly with supervisors and crew leaders to correct deficiencies and improve productivity and quality.
* Manage employee scheduling, attendance, staffing needs, productivity, training, discipline, and overall field performance.
* Ensure sufficient staffing and equipment are available at all times to meet the City's service requirements.
* Oversee specialized **athletic\-field and sports\-turf maintenance**, including reel mowing, aeration, verticutting, deep\-tine aeration, topdressing, interseeding, turf renovation, fraise mowing, sod preparation, and related operations.
* Work closely with irrigation technicians to ensure irrigation systems are operating properly and repairs are completed promptly.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors for specialized work and material deliveries.
* Review contract specifications regularly and ensure field operations remain in full compliance.
* Prepare, complete, review, and submit **all reports, schedules, documentation, inspection records, work logs, service reports, and other information required by the City**.
* Track corrective\-action requests and ensure issues identified by the City are resolved quickly and documented appropriately.
* Attend meetings and site walks with City representatives and company leadership.
* Maintain professional and proactive communication with City staff.
* Monitor material usage, labor productivity, equipment utilization, and overall project efficiency.
* Assist company management with controlling project costs while **never sacrificing the quality or contractual performance expected by the City**.
* Ensure crews comply with all applicable safety requirements, company procedures, and City standards.
* Maintain accurate records relating to staffing, work performed, additional work, materials, equipment, and contract compliance.
* Recognize potential contractual issues or additional\-work opportunities and immediately communicate them to company management.
* Take complete ownership of the project and ensure that issues are followed through **from identification to final resolution**.

Landscape Knowledge Is Essential

This position requires considerably more landscape expertise than a traditional project\-management role.

The Project Manager must have a strong working understanding of areas including:

* Commercial and municipal landscape maintenance
* Sports\-field and athletic\-turf maintenance
* Reel and rotary mowing practices
* Turfgrass identification and management
* Fertilization programs
* Aeration, verticutting, overseeding and topdressing
* Turf renovation and establishment
* Shrub and groundcover maintenance
* Proper pruning techniques
* Weed identification and control
* Integrated Pest Management
* Irrigation tr

jobs.title: Assistant Account Manager, Commercial Lines
jobs.description:
**ABOUT HUB:**


In a rapidly changing world, HUB advises businesses and individuals on how to prepare for the unexpected. As one of the worlds' largest insurance brokers, our focus is dedicated to providing our customers with the peace of mind that what matters most will be protected\-through unrelenting advocacy and tailored insurance solutions that put our clients in control. Our growing team of professionals across North America represents a broad, deep and one\-of \-a kind aggregation of entrepreneurs and leaders recognized for their excellence throughout the insurance community.

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**


The Assistant Account Manager provides a high level of support in obtaining, maintaining, expanding, and servicing commercial lines accounts. This position assists with certificates of insurance, policy changes, gathering renewal information preparing client presentations, general account assistance and other special projects. This position will require meeting daily production standards, goals and service commitments.

**DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assists the Account Management team with all aspects of the account\-service process.
* Responds to policy inquiries via phone and email. May field phone calls from insureds regarding questions about their coverage, changes, additions, payments, cancellations etc.
* Responsible for service work as needed on a daily basis. Including but not limited to the following: certificates of insurance, policy changes and client payments.
* Participates in the renewal preparation process, including generating renewal updates on accounts.
* Assists with marketing clients to carriers.
* Assists with coordinating premium financing and the collection of premiums.
* Checks policies/endorsements and audits for accuracy.
* Prepares quotes and proposals.
* Provides professional, courteous service to our clients, carrier representatives, underwriters, business partners, and HUB colleagues, resulting in a rate of account retention that meets or exceeds expectations.
* Maintains accurate and organized account files by appropriately documenting conversations with clients and carrier representatives; updates all HUB computer systems and automated agency management systems; ensures the accuracy of data
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High School / GED
* 1\-2 years insurance industry experience or equivalent combination of education \& experience
* Property \& Causality License required within first 6 months
* Experience in Medical Malpractice Insurance a plus

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages.
* Ability to effectively and professionally communicate orally and in writing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to efficiently gather pertinent information and facts, analyze and solve problems timely and thoroughly.
* Ability to prioritize and organize multiple tasks and responsibilities in order to complete assignments on time and with optimal accuracy.
* Ability to respond to customer needs, solicit customer feedback to improve service, and handle difficult or emotional customer situations promptly and accurately.
* Computer skills: proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Outlook.
* Critical Thinking: Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.
* Desire to learn and grow within the insurance industry.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* This position primarily involves remaining in a stationary position for the majority of the workday.
* The person in this position frequently communicates with colleagues and clients both in person and on the telephone; Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information.
* Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
* The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

**WHY CHOOSE HUB?**


Throughout our network of more than 450 HUB offices in North America, we offer a competitive, exciting and friendly work environment that strategically positions our employees for longevity and success. At HUB, we believe in investing in the future of our employees, and provide continuous opportunities for growth and development*.* Our entrepreneurial culture fosters an environment that empowers our people to make the best decisions for our customers and organization, focusing on expanding the industry knowledge of our insurance professionals to better serve our valued clients. We are committed to providing you with competitive and flexible benefits options that are rooted in your current needs, yet evolves as your needs change over time. Join us in taking the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction.

**Salary:** $65,000–$85,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** Orange, CA – In Person

**About Hampton Tedder Electric**

Hampton Tedder Electric Co. (HTE) was established in 1958 and is a family\-owned and operated high\-voltage electrical contractor with a proven track record of safe, compliant, and reliable service.

We provide high\-voltage design, construction, maintenance, and testing for overhead, underground, and underwater high\-voltage systems.

We are seeking a motivated, creative, and highly organized **Marketing Associate** to join our team and support the company's marketing, communications, brand, and business development activities.

This is a hands\-on, mid\-level marketing position for someone who enjoys variety and is comfortable working on multiple projects at the same time. The Marketing Associate will work closely with company leadership, business development, operations, project teams, and outside vendors to create and coordinate marketing materials and communications that accurately represent HTE's capabilities, people, projects, and accomplishments.

The ideal candidate is a strong writer and communicator with excellent attention to detail, good organizational skills, and a willingness to learn the high\-voltage electrical and construction industry.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for a marketing professional who wants to build experience in **construction, electrical contracting, utilities, infrastructure, and business\-to\-business marketing.**

**Position Summary**

The Marketing Associate will support the day\-to\-day execution of the company's marketing activities across digital, print, social media, events, email, website content, promotional materials, and business development support.

The successful candidate will help ensure that HTE presents a consistent, professional, and compelling image across all marketing channels.

* Assist with developing project descriptions, company capability descriptions, employee biographies, and other marketing content.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about crafting compelling digital experiences and driving impactful marketing strategies? We are seeking a dynamic **Digital Marketing Specialist** to join our innovative team! In this role, you will lead the development and execution of comprehensive digital marketing campaigns that elevate brand visibility, boost engagement, and generate measurable results. Your expertise in SEO, paid advertising, content creation, and analytics will be instrumental in shaping our online presence and achieving business objectives. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-paced environment where creativity meets data\-driven decision\-making.

**Duties**

* Develop, implement, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels including SEM (Search Engine Marketing), social media advertising, email marketing, and paid search marketing campaigns.
* Manage and monitor paid advertising campaigns using platforms such as Google Ads (Google AdWords), Facebook Advertising, and other social media advertising tools to maximize ROI.
* Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to enhance organic search rankings; optimize website content for search engines using SEO best practices.
* Create engaging content for websites, blogs, social media platforms, and email campaigns that resonates with target audiences.
* Utilize web analytics reporting tools like Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager to track campaign performance, analyze user behavior, and generate actionable insights.
* Manage website content using content management systems such as WordPress; perform website management tasks including updates, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Design visually appealing graphics and multimedia assets using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite to support marketing initiatives.
* Implement marketing automation strategies to nurture leads and improve conversion rates through personalized messaging.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to coordinate digital campaign setup, testing, and performance marketing efforts aligned with business goals.
* Monitor industry trends in digital marketing to continually refine strategies for social media management, web analytics, paid advertising campaigns, and SEO.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong understanding of SEM, SEO, social media marketing, paid advertising campaign management, and web analytics reporting.
* Proficiency with SEO tools, Google Analytics, Google Ads (Google AdWords), Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation platforms.
* Skilled in content creation with a solid grasp of graphic design tools like Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Hands\-on experience managing websites using WordPress or similar content management systems; familiarity with HTML/CSS is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to manage paid advertising campaigns across multiple channels including Facebook Advertising and Google Ads.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data from web analytics tools to inform strategy adjustments.
* Excellent communication skills for creating compelling content and collaborating effectively with team members.
* Technical proficiency in website management, keyword research, performance marketing tactics, and social media management platforms.
* Knowledge of e\-commerce platforms is advantageous for supporting online sales initiatives.

Join us as a Digital Marketing Specialist where your innovative ideas will shape our digital footprint! Bring your enthusiasm for digital strategy combined with technical expertise — together we’ll create impactful campaigns that drive growth and engagement across all channels!

Pay: $26\.24 \- $28\.93 per hour

Expected hours: 5\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

Headquartered in the United States, TP\-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi\-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP\-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.


We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP\-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high\-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.


Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.


The **Influencer Marketing Specialist** will play a key role in scaling TP\-Link's influencer program into a high\-performing customer acquisition channel. jobs.description:
Part\-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes \| East Bay, CA**  
**Starting at 10\-15 hours/week, with potential to grow to twice that \+**  
**$28\-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people\-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience.

This is a part\-time position to start, with approximately **10\-15 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day\-to\-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the ownership team.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients during active construction
* Communicating clearly, professionally, kindly, and proactively with clients
* Coordinating schedules, materials, deliveries, subcontractors, and jobsite logistics
* Visiting active jobsites to monitor progress, organization, and quality
* Reviewing plans and ensuring the work being built reflects the approved design and scope
* Maintaining high standards for craftsmanship, details, cleanliness, and overall presentation
* Communicating clearly with the field crew and helping resolve questions or issues as they arise
* Identifying potential problems early and helping develop practical solutions
* Keeping projects organized and on track with established scope, schedule, and cost targets
* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication
* Helping coordinate change requests and ensuring work outside the approved scope is properly addressed
* Participating in client meetings, site walks, and project closeouts

You will **not** be responsible for estimating, setting project pricing, budgeting, payroll, or making company financial decisions.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **extremely dependable, organized, communicative, and thoughtful**. You don't need to be a landscape architect or designer, but you do need to understand landscape construction and have a genuine interest in how things are built.

The right person will:

* Have strong practical knowledge of landscape construction, hardscape, irrigation, planting, or related construction
* Be able to read and understand plans and translate them into real\-world construction
* Have exceptionally strong communication skills
* Be comfortable and confident working directly with clients
* Be kind, patient, and professional even and especially when dealing with difficult situations
* Communicate confidently and respectfully with field crews while maintaining clear expectations and a collaborative working relationship
* Have a high standard for craftsmanship and attention to detail
* Notice when something isn't right and be willing to speak up
* Be proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do
* Be highly organized and capable of keeping track of many moving pieces
* Be comfortable taking ownership and following things through to completion
* Understand that the details of the client experience matter just as much as the finished landscape

We are a **small, high\-end boutique landscape design and installation company**, and our clients expect a thoughtful, professional, highly communicative experience. We are looking for someone who naturally understands that standard and can help us maintain it as the company grows.

**Growth \& Training**

This position will begin with approximately **10\-15 hours per week**, with the potential to grow to twice that as responsibilities increase.

Initially, you will **shadow the owner and learn how we manage projects, communicate with clients, work with our crew, and maintain our standards**. As you become familiar with our way of working, you will gradually take on more responsibility for coordinating projects and installations, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination as one of the owners steps back from that role. You will continue to work closely alongside the other owner and our field leadership.

We are looking for someone who is naturally intuitive, observant, and proactive. A good candidate is someone who notices what needs attention, anticipates problems before they become problems, and can often see the next step without having to be told. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills, take on increasing responsibility, and grow with the company over time.

**Why Work With Us**

We are a growing company with a collaborative team culture and a genuine commitment to the people who work with us. We care about doing excellent work, treating people well, and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding our employee benefits and opportunities, including:

* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performance\-based bonuses
* Employee discounts
* PTO
* Opportunities for advancement and increasing responsibility
* A supportive, collaborative team environment
* A company culture that values communication, respect, craftsmanship, and personal growth
* Benefits currently being developed, including a 401(k) with employer matching and healthcare benefits for eligiible candidates

**Location:** Bay Area, CA (Must understand local travel/traffic considerations) **Position Type:** Full\-Time  

**About the Role**  

We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented **Sales \& Project Coordinator** to partner directly with our Account Management team. The goal of this role is to maximize our sales capacity by taking ownership of critical administrative, estimating, and project\-processing workflows.  

This is not a traditional administrative assistant position; you will act as the engine behind our sales pipeline, ensuring projects move efficiently from initial site survey to final delivery while allowing our sales team to focus on client relationships and closing business.  

**Core Responsibilities**  

* **Survey \& Project Processing:** Organize and process site survey notes, compile photos and measurements, and prepare comprehensive project information for quoting.
* **Estimating \& System Support:** Build estimate drafts, enter products and line items, and assist with formal quote preparation within our **CoreBridge POS** management system.
* **Design \& File Support:** Use Adobe Illustrator to scale and review files, verify measurements/specifications, and package accurate information for our design team.
* **Standards \& Compliance:** Learn and maintain key client sign standards for major accounts to ensure project consistency and pre\-production compliance.
* **Vendor \& Subcontractor Coordination:** Request pricing from vendors, proactively follow up on outstanding quotes, and coordinate seamless communication with subcontractors.
* **Scheduling \& Logistics:** Manage the account manager’s calendar, schedule appointments, and coordinate surveys with an understanding of Bay Area traffic and travel logistics.
* **Project Tracking:** Maintain project task lists, identify immediate next steps, follow up on outstanding action items, and help push projects through the pipeline.

**Desired Skills \& Qualifications**  

* **Highly Organized \& Detail\-Oriented:** You take pride in precision and don't let small details slip through the cracks.
* **Strong Communicator:** Comfortable and professional when making phone calls and sending emails to clients, vendors, and team members.
* **Tech Savvy:** Familiar with **Google Workspace** and capable of quickly learning proprietary industry software like **CoreBridge**.
* **Design Tool Familiarity:** Experience or familiarity with **Adobe Illustrator** is mandatory.
* **Problem Solver:** A self\-starter who can independently identify bottlenecks and solve problems without waiting for instructions.
* **Adaptable Learner:** Willing and eager to learn industry\-specific terminology and technical sign standards.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**  

When you succeed, the whole team succeeds. In this role, your impact will be felt immediately through:  

* Faster quote turnaround times and more consistent client follow\-up.
* Highly organized, accurate project files that keep complex jobs moving forward efficiently.
* Reduced bottlenecks and stress across the production pipeline.

Increased sales capacity, allowing the account team to drive revenue and scale business.

All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to FASTSIGNS Corporate.*

jobs.title: Program Specialist II - Clinical Programs (Respiratory Health/HIV)
jobs.description:
Description:
**Position Summary:**


The Clinical Program Specialist II (Respiratory Health \& HIV) serves as an experienced direct care, navigation, and outreach lead within Roots’ Clinical Programs department. Representing Roots Community Health Center, this role blends clinical program support, patient outreach, care coordination, and health education focused on high\-priority conditions including HIV, sexual health, asthma, COVID\-19, and infectious respiratory diseases.


As a Level II specialist, the incumbent manages larger patient panels and leads field\-based outreach initiatives targeted at eliminating health disparities in underserved, low\-income, and unsheltered communities.


Requirements:#### **Essential Functions:**

#### **Direct Care Coordination \& Patient Navigation**

* Serve as a direct liaison between patients and Roots' Clinical Programs, facilitating seamless recruitment, enrollment, intake, and longitudinal care retention.
* Manage and track large client panel lists, using prioritization skills to schedule and confirm program initiation, specialist referrals, and routine follow\-up visits.
* Conduct patient intakes and comprehensive assessments (both in\-person and via phone), connecting patients to Patient Services for public benefit enrollment (e.g., Medi\-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKS) and basic needs support.
* Assist patients in understanding disease management concepts and guidelines for HIV prevention/treatment (including PrEP/PEP) and respiratory care (e.g., asthma control, COVID\-19 management).
* Partner closely with internal navigation teams, medical providers, and clinic staff to ensure an uninterrupted continuum of care and share patient progress updates.

#### **Outreach, In\-Reach, \& Community Engagement**

* Conduct targeted phone outreach and clinic "in\-reach" to existing patients to build awareness and engagement in HIV and Respiratory Health programs.
* Lead field and street\-based outreach to engage hard\-to\-reach populations, including individuals living in encampments, shelters, or temporary housing.
* Represent Roots as an instrumental lead during weekend and evening community outreach events, managing on\-site logistics, health screenings, and harm\-reduction education.
* Build and maintain collaborative partnerships with local Emergency Departments, Community\-Based Organizations, and local health initiatives to streamline external patient referrals.

#### **Documentation, Data \& Program Support**

* Maintain up\-to\-date, highly accurate records of all patient encounters, referrals, and outreach activities across Electronic Health Record systems and specialized tracking databases.
* Ensure strict adherence to HIPAA compliance and patient privacy standards across all interactions and data entries.
* Assist program leadership in tracking program and contract deliverables tied to HIV and respiratory grants, identifying operational bottlenecks or data collection gaps.
* Meet regularly with Program Coordinators and Managers for case reviews, workflow planning, and program strategy development.

### **Education \& Certification Requirements**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED required. Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Social Work, or a related field preferred.
* **Certification:** Completion of an accredited Community Health Worker certification program (or willingness to complete within 6 months of hire).
* **Lived Experience:** Lived experience within or a strong connection to the communities served by Roots Community Health Center.

### **Preferred Qualifications \& Work Experience**

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
==================



Anthropic has an ambitious mission with high stakes and tight timelines. In some cases, the talent we need to achieve our vision can't be accessed through traditional recruiting alone. That's where M\&A comes in, and this role is what keeps it running smoothly.



We're looking for a Recruiting M\&A Program Specialist to join our Talent team and coordinate the interview experience behind our acquisition hiring. You'll be a key point of contact across Corporate Development, Legal, People, and the technical organization, coordinating interviews and guiding candidates and incoming employees from first conversation through to their start date. Your work will be challenging and unique, and it directly supports Anthropic's efforts to remain on the frontier.  

  

Role required to work out of the Anthropic San Francisco Office \- Relocation available.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Be a primary point of contact for candidates, delivering a warm, high\-touch, and discreet experience from first conversation through their start date. Make sure people going through a sensitive transition feel supported and informed at every step.
* Coordinate across Corporate Development, Legal, People, and technical leadership, keeping everyone informed, flagging what needs attention, and keeping the process moving.
* Be the primary point of contact for scheduling logistics for acquisition\-related hiring, navigating complex, confidential scenarios across time zones and multiple stakeholders.

* Take on other high\-priority recruiting and operations projects as needed and grow within the role over time.

* Experience with confidential or sensitive work where discretion, trust, and sound judgment are essential
* Strong organizational instincts and comfort creating structure in ambiguous, fast\-moving situations
* Comfort working efficiently with AI tools; experience with Claude
* A genuine interest in Anthropic's mission and the role M\&A plays in supporting it

Annual Salary:


$120,640 \- $145,600 USD

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

jobs.title: Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About WCN**


Wildlife Conservation Network is a rapidly growing leader in wildlife conservation, protecting endangered wildlife by supporting conservationists who ensure wildlife and people coexist and thrive. Using a collaborative, entrepreneurial, innovative, and philanthropically generous approach, WCN gives conservation leaders access to the donors, resources, and tools they need to reverse the crises facing threatened species — raising philanthropic funding and channeling it to a vetted network of Conservation Partners and through species\-focused Wildlife Funds that support over 125 species in more than 50 countries.

**Position Summary**


The Office Operations Coordinator keeps WCN's office, facilities, technology, events logistics, and finance\-support functions running day to day. This is a generalist role by design — the person in it moves across a wide range of tasks and prioritizes what's most urgent on a given day — and it's a strong entry point into nonprofit operations for someone early in their career who wants to grow. Reporting to the CFO, this role supports the whole organization and works most visibly alongside Donor Engagement and Events around Expo and other donor\-facing events. This role is anticipated to be in\-office full time.

**Mission, Vision \& Values Alignment**


This role keeps the operational backbone of WCN — office, technology, events, and finance\-support functions — running smoothly, freeing the organization to focus on its Conservation Partners, Wildlife Funds, and Rising Wildlife Leaders work in the field. It lives WCN's values directly: *Service* (the role exists to support other teams' work), *Integrity* (trustworthy handling of financially sensitive tasks like check deposits and petty cash), *Community* (visitor hospitality and internal culture/engagement support), and *Collaboration* (close partnership with Finance, Donor Engagement, and Events).

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Office \& Facilities** — Keep the physical office running day to day: phone coverage, visitor reception, supplies and systems, vendor relationships (e.g., janitorial), and a well\-organized, well\-used physical space.
* **Administrative Support** — Keep WCN organized and staff supported: general inquiries, mail, filing, new\-hire onboarding logistics, shared calendars, and employee engagement activities.
* **Finance Support** — Own the day\-to\-day financial tasks that keep operations running cleanly: check deposits (primary owner), petty cash, vendor invoices and payments, subscription tracking, and monthly credit card reconciliation, in close partnership with the Finance team.
* **Technology \& Equipment** — Maintain WCN's computer/equipment inventory and serve as the primary point of contact with WCN's IT support vendor.
* **Events \& Cross\-Team Support** — Coordinate staff and partner travel bookings and expense reporting, and support logistics for internal and external events, including Expo (storage, merchandise, partner packages).
* **Ad Hoc** — Take on cross\-departmental administrative support and special projects (Development, Programs, Finance) as they come up.

**Qualifications**

* 1\-3 years of office/administrative experience
* Strong general computer and technology skills (e.g., spreadsheets, documents, presentation software)
* Experience with cloud\-based collaborative tools (Google Drive, email); willingness to learn Salesforce basics with training
* Experience answering/routing calls on a multi\-line phone system or serving in a front\-desk/reception role
* Experience coordinating with vendors or service providers (scheduling, ordering, basic contract/invoice tracking)
* Familiarity with mail/shipping logistics (USPS, UPS, FedEx)
* Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable with variety and frequent interruptions (phones, visitors, vendors) rather than sustained single\-task focus; self\-directed enough to keep a long list of recurring tasks moving without close daily supervision
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds and sit for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Genuine interest in wildlife conservation and strong alignment with WCN's Core Values

**Compensation \& Benefits**


Compensation is expected to be in the $33\-36 an hour range based on qualifications and experience. Benefits include: medical, dental, and vision insurance contributions; chiropractic/acupuncture; basic life insurance and AD\&D Health FSA and dependent care (pre\-tax); a retirement plan with a 100% employer match on employee contributions up to 6% of salary; 11 paid holidays plus 1 paid floating holiday; 15 days of paid vacation in the first year (\+1 day per year worked); paid sick leave; and employee wellness, mental health, and discount programs.

**Equal Opportunity**


WCN is committed to the principles of being an equal opportunity employer (EOE). WCN’s organizational policies, practices, programs, activities and decisions regarding employment are not based on a person’s race, color, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, parental status, housing status, or other protected status, in accordance with applicable law. Black, Indigenous, people of color, women, individuals identifying with the LGBTQIA\+ community, or members of other underrepresented groups in the conservation sector are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
---------------


Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


We're hiring a Recruiting Coordinator to own the machinery behind our hiring — the systems, process, and enablement that let recruiters and hiring managers move fast without dropping anything. This is not a scheduling\-only role: you'll get into the guts of our ATS, build the reports that tell us where hiring is working and where it's stuck, and stand up new programs end to end. You'll sit at the center of every hire, balancing the needs of recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates, and you'll have real ownership over how talent ops runs as we scale. Based out of SF or NY, this role is an onsite position and you'll work closely with the recruiting team from day one.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Manage candidate logistics and communications, balancing the priorities of recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates
* Own day\-to\-day operations of our ATS (Ashby) — configuration, hygiene, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement
* Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to inform recruiting decisions
* Design and launch new recruiting programs and tools — run enablement sessions with recruiters, interviewers, etc and act as the ongoing point person
* Identify and fix breakdowns in process before they become bottlenecks
* Keep our talent ops stack (ATS, scheduling tools, sourcing tools) integrated and running smoothly

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2\+ years of experience in recruiting operations, talent ops, or a related coordination role
* Genuine interest in getting into the nitty gritty of talent ops — systems, tooling, ATS configuration, and enablement, not just scheduling
* Strong communication skills
* Comfort building reports and dashboards, with a working understanding of core recruiting metrics
* Track record of launching a new program or process and driving adoption of it
* High attention to detail and ownership — things don't fall through the cracks on your watch
* Ashby experience is a strong plus, especially having gone through an ATS implementation or migration

**What We Offer:**
------------------


We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent\-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.


We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

* **Top\-tier compensation:** Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally.
* **Stock options:** Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options.

jobs.description:
**About Blueprint**



Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.



Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.



At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.


**Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.**

### **In This Role**



You will provide administrative and operational support to a manager and a larger on\-site team in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. You will manage calendars and schedules, coordinate travel, meetings, and events, and support day\-to\-day business operations. You will also assist with hardware and procurement ordering, space and facilities coordination, new\-hire onboarding, and a variety of administrative and ad\-hoc requests. The role requires flexibility to support multiple teams and work across two nearby office locations as business needs evolve.

* Provide administrative support to an individual manager and broader team.
* Manage calendars, schedules, meetings, and appointments.
* Coordinate domestic and business travel arrangements.
* Plan and support meetings, team events, and onsite activities.
* Assist with new\-hire onboarding and related administrative activities.
* Process and coordinate hardware, supplies, and procurement orders.
* Support department financial and administrative operations.
* Coordinate space, facilities, and office\-related needs.
* Respond to day\-to\-day administrative and ad\-hoc requests.
* Manage multiple priorities while supporting varying business needs across teams.
* Work onsite across two nearby office locations as required.

	+ Outlook

* Experience with procurement, ordering, or purchasing\-related activities.
* Ability to manage schedules and coordinate day\-to\-day administrative activities.
* Ability to support multiple teams and adapt to changing business priorities.
* Ability and willingness to work fully onsite across both designated office locations.
* Availability to support a long\-term contract assignment, including potential extensions.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Previous experience supporting a corporate or enterprise environment.
* Business administration or related academic/professional background.
* Strong technical aptitude and comfort learning workplace technologies.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and multiple requests.
* Familiarity with Outlook and other administrative support platforms.
* Experience supporting procurement, hardware ordering, or office operations.
* Flexibility to support different teams and business functions.
* Comfortable traveling between two nearby office locations while maintaining a consistent onsite presence.

Onsite: Willing to work across Mountain View(1 day) and Santa Clara (4 days) office locations.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Position:** Member Events Operations Manager

**Department:** Member Events / Programming

**Reports To:** Director of Programming

**FLSA:** Salary – Exempt

 **COMPANY PROFILE**


The Battery is San Francisco's premier modern\-era private social club, recognized by the Michelin Guide with Two Keys — one of the highest distinctions awarded to a hospitality property worldwide. Set within a historic building on Battery Street, the Club features seven distinctive bars and lounges alongside acclaimed dining rooms serving breakfast, brunch, lunch, and dinner. The Battery also offers a boutique 14\-suite hotel, including penthouse accommodations, elegant private event spaces, lush gardens, and sweeping views of the San Francisco skyline. Members enjoy a dynamic cultural calendar of world\-class speakers, performing arts, curated experiences, publications, and excursions. Through Battery Powered, the Club's member\-funded 501(c)(3\) foundation, The Battery has directed more than $35 million in grants to organizations building a stronger society — reflecting a rare combination of world\-class hospitality and purpose.

**POSITION PROFILE**


The Member Events Operations Manager owns the day\-to\-day execution of The Battery's Member Events programming, running the majority of the Club's recurring events — trivia nights, comedy, Saturday concerts, and other repeat programming — from setup through breakdown. This is not an occasional floor\-support role; on most days, this person is the operational lead on the ground for whatever Member Event is happening.


Beyond live execution, this role owns the operational and administrative backbone of the department: maintaining the recurring programming calendar, advancing events with artists, speakers, and vendors ahead of time, and handling invoicing and post\-event documentation. This is a hands\-on, floor\-based position suited for someone with hospitality and event experience who thrives in live environments, understands service flow, and can manage staff and logistics in real time. The role works closely with Programming and Food \& Beverage leadership to deliver consistent, well\-run events that meet the Club's standards.


Because this role supports live events and Club operations, flexibility is essential. Hours will shift based on the event calendar and business needs; the position requires regular evening work, including late nights, as well as occasional Sundays and holidays. Candidates should be comfortable working a schedule that varies week to week.


This is an on\-site position located in San Francisco.

**BATTERY PROGRAMS**


Member Events produces a wide range of programming, including but not limited to: high\-end culinary events, wine and spirit tastings, comedy nights, live music concerts, lectures and panels, trivia and game nights, networking events, DJ nights, and family programs.

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or for other reasons.

**Event \& Service Execution**

* Serve as the on\-site operational lead for the majority of Member Events, including high\-frequency recurring programs (trivia, comedy nights, Saturday concerts, and similar repeat events), overseeing setup, service flow, and breakdown.
* Ensure BEOs and event timelines are followed accurately during live events.
* Execute food and beverage service plans in coordination with F\&B and Culinary teams.
* Act as a host presence during events, supporting Members and resolving service issues as they arise.
* Close out the Point of Sale (POS) system and provide receipts and an event recap to the Member Events team.

**Staffing \& Floor Leadership**

* Supervise hourly event staff and outsourced labor during events.
* Lead pre\-event briefings to align staff on service expectations and timing.
* Support training and reinforcement of service standards during events.
* Escalate staffing or performance issues to department leadership when needed.

**Event Management Support**

* Partner with the Programming team to translate event plans into operational execution.
* Coordinate with AV, Engineering, Front Desk, and Security on event\-day needs.
* Assist with furniture layouts, run\-of\-show coordination, and basic production logistics.
* Advance events with artists, speakers, and vendors ahead of time, confirming logistics, hospitality needs, schedules, and any special requirements.
* Serve as the main point of contact for artists, vendors, and speakers for select programs.
* Help establish and maintain strong relationships with artists, speakers, and vendors that come to The Battery.

**Administrative \& Operational Support**

* Own and maintain the recurring programming calendar, including monthly repeat programming BEOs and floor plans using existing templates.
* Assist with invoice collection and coding, vendor paperwork, and post\-event documentation.
* Create weekly event signage using templates.
* Support expense tracking and reconciliation for events.
* Maintain operational notes, staffing feedback, and event follow\-ups.
* Additional administrative projects as time allows.

**Cross\-Department Support**

* Provide occasional support for Private Events during slower programming periods.
* Communicate clearly with supervisors regarding event outcomes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

* Demonstrated experience managing service staff during live events.
* Can creatively solve problems and effectively implement solutions.
* Must be able to deal with vendors, presenters, and talent in a professional manner while maintaining a composed demeanor in high\-stress situations.

jobs.description:
**About Cleerly**



We're Cleerly – a healthcare company that's revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world's leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world\-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on\-site in a location.



Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value\-based, AI\-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly's solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world's largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person's risk of heart attacks.



At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description.



While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time.

*Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. preferred.

propositions.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About XLI**
At XLI, we build more than just structures. We build careers, relationships, and the future. As a purpose\-driven general contractor, our culture is grounded in servant leadership, accountability, and collaboration. Our Assistant Project Managers are integral to driving success across our projects and shaping the future of construction.  

**Position Summary**
The Assistant Project Manager (APM) plays a critical role in supporting the successful planning and execution of construction projects. In partnership with the Project Manager and Superintendent, the APM oversees documentation, procurement, budgeting, schedule adherence, and quality control. This role is ideal for a dynamic builder with strong attention to detail, leadership capabilities, and a passion for continuous learning.  

**Key Responsibilities*** Review contracts, assess risk, and communicate key areas of exposure to the project team.
* Lead the bid process by developing detailed instructions to bidders, ensuring scope coverage, accuracy, and appropriate risk mitigation.
* Support subcontractor buyout and selection processes, including subcontract execution and issue resolution.
* Assemble and manage the project control estimate.
* Manage all aspects of construction management, including:
* Preconstruction
* Scheduling
* Procurement
* Submittals
* RFIs
* Change orders
* Budgeting
* Forecasting
* Billing
* Project closeout
* Ensure project permits, inspections, and tests are accurately identified and scheduled.
* Own the project procurement plan and procurement log, proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
* Foster effective relationships with clients and design teams through consistent communication and leadership during Owner/Architect/Contractor (OAC) meetings and site walks.
* Maintain document control accuracy and timeliness.
* Leverage internal resources including VDC, Lean practices, SPW, XL Shop, and other tools to drive project and team effectiveness.
* Train and mentor Project Engineers, Project Administrators, and Project Accountants.
* Promote and model XLI's core values, safety culture, and operational excellence.

 **Required Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of construction experience, preferably as a Senior Project Engineer or Assistant Project Manager.
* Experience working on healthcare, education, life sciences, civic, or commercial office projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing or assisting with small projects.
* Proficiency with:
* Microsoft Office
* Procore
* Primavera P6
* Timberline
* Vista
* Solid understanding of:
* MEP trades
* Scheduling
* Permit processes
* OSHA 10 Certification.
* Ability to build trust across project stakeholders and internal teams.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.

 **Core Competencies*** XLI Stewardship
* Managerial Courage
* Bridge Builder
* People Developer
* Continuous Learner
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Edge

 **Compensation**
In accordance with California's Pay Transparency Laws (SB 1162\), XLI is committed to fair and equitable compensation.* Base Salary Range: $120,000 – $135,000 annually
* Eligible for annual performance bonus program
* Eligible for vehicle reimbursement


Compensation will be determined based on experience, education, qualifications, and internal equity.  

**Why Join XLI?**
At XLI, we offer more than a job. We offer a purpose. From career development to mentorship and a people\-first culture, we are proud to support your growth in construction leadership.  

**Benefits Include*** Competitive salary and annual bonus program
* Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision
* 401(k) with company match
* Generous paid time off and company holidays
* Monthly vehicle reimbursement
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement
* Opportunities to work on meaningful, high\-impact projects

jobs.description:
**About Ogilvy**


Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture\-changing, value\-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports \& entertainment, PR \& social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the \#1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

  

**Brand Project Coordinator/ Account Manager – 3\-month contract**

**About the Role:**


Ogilvy Sydney is looking for part\-time account management support for an opportunity, supporting our client with the final stages of key brand, campaign and operational work through to the end of December 2026\.


This role would suit an experienced Account Manager or Senior Account Manager who is available to start ASAP and commit to three days per week.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Coordinate consumer testing for research projects, including materials, timelines and approvals.
* Support new product launches through artwork coordination and administrative tasks.
* Support media and creative implementation, completing the remaining 2026 deliverables and coordinating implementation of the 2027 plans.
* Coordinate influencer activity, with scope to be confirmed.
* Coordinate the rollout of e\-commerce assets and website updates.
* Maintain project trackers, timelines and deliverables across internal cross\-functional teams and agency partners.
* Follow up with stakeholders, manage competing priorities and keep projects moving across agency and client teams.

**Experience \& Skills:**


* Experienced Account Manager or Senior Account Manager level, ideally with FMCG, beauty, integrated campaign or e\-commerce experience.
* Highly organised and proactive, with strong project coordination skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once.
* Comfortable working in a secondment\-style arrangement, building relationships with both client and agency stakeholders.
* Confident following up with stakeholders, managing timelines and keeping deliverables on track.
* Strong attention to detail, clear communication skills and a practical, solutions\-focused approach.

\#LI\-CO1


At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game\-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self\-expression.


We believe in building powerful teams with purpose \- and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.


Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.


Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.


If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at accommodations@ogilvy.com. Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.

jobs.title: Peer Program Specialist, 74 Avenue A
jobs.description:
Description:
**Lived experience as a consumer of mental health, substance use, and/or homeless services is required**

**Position:** Peer Program Specialist, 74 Avenue A

**Reports to:** Program Director

**Function:** Provides direct service to clients in their homes, assisting with training in skills of daily living.

**Location:** Queens (Queens Village)

**Schedule:** Fridays through Mondays (9:00am\-4:00pm)

**Tasks:**

* Teaches skills for maintaining personal hygiene, laundry and apartment cleaning.
* Monitors overall maintenance of apartments and alerts program director of maintenance problems.
* Teaches skills for budgeting, shopping, meal planning, preparation and clean\-up.
* Teaches skills for self\-preservation, monitors living units for safety and cleanliness.
* Administers the client cooking safety test.
* Monitors, documents and teaches self\-administration of medication, according to program policy and procedures.
* Report incidents or behavioral changes in residents to supervisor.
* Teaches travel skills and escorts clients, where needed.
* Facilitates/co\-facilitates groups, as requested.
* Documents services rendered and client progress in a timely manner.
* Assists in building self\-advocacy skills to effectively communicate with client’s supports and treatment team
* Supports recovery skill building goals to decrease frequency of contact with emergency services
* Attends training and other duties as assigned by supervisory staff


Requirements:

Lived experience receiving mental health services such as past or current participant of behavioral health, substance or homeless services; commitment to assist others in attaining their mental health recovery goals in part through sharing own personal lived experiences. Completion of or on track to receive New York Certified Peer Program (NYCPS) certification preferred. High School diploma or G.E.D. preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Basic computer and data entry skills.

**Peer Program Specialist (Single Site), Certified – P/T Hrly Salary:** $22\.07

**Peer Program Specialist (Single Site), Non\-certified – P/T Hrly Salary:** $22\.00


Please include a resume, cover letter and contact information for 3 professional references.
