We are seeking an Operations Coordinator to become part of our exceptional team. The Operations Coordinator is the first point of contact for our clients and a central support to our office team. This is a growth position. As we prepare for disciplined expansion over the next 3\-5 years, the person in this role will start by owning our client communications and booking support, and grow into broader operational responsibility as our systems and volume expand.

**About Us**

We specialize in high\-detail housekeeping and post\-construction cleaning for interior designers, architects, and luxury property managers throughout New York City. Our reputation is built on discretion, reliability, and meticulous attention to detail.

We are a small, tenured and welcoming team with over 40 employees on the field. We are a large family, with a strong community \- family culture. We have very little turnover and seek employees with similar priorities.

**Position Overview**

The Operations Coordinator is the front door to New York's Little Elves. This position owns how the office operates day to day, including: first\-line phone coverage, client email correspondence, website inquiries that bring in new work, and supports the booking process that turns those inquiries into scheduled jobs.

This is not a receptionist role. Phones and inbox are where the job begins, not where it ends. The right person will learn how the whole operation runs, take on projects that improve it, and grow with a company that is actively expanding. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail oriented and productive under pressure. Successful candidates thrive in a fast\-pasted environment where priorities shift quickly, are comfortable being friendly and can remain professional under pressure.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Client Communication*

● Answer incoming phone calls as the first point of contact

● Respond to client email correspondence with the care and detail our clients expect

● Manage inquiries submitted through our website

● Document client requests, reschedules, and job changes

*Booking Support*

● Support the booking process from first inquiry through confirmed job

● Gather and verify the details required to quote and schedule work accurately

● Follow up on outstanding inquiries so no request goes unanswered

*Operational Support*

● Work in our scheduling system daily and become the team's most fluent user of it

● Support the supply and inventory function alongside our operations team

● Maintain accurate client records across our systems

*Growth and Improvement*

● Take on defined projects that improve how the office runs

● Identify friction in day\-to\-day processes and bring solutions forward

● Note: Payroll, crew scheduling, and crew assignment remain with our General Manager and President. This role supports the operation; it does not run it.\*

**Qualifications**

● Experience in an administrative, coordination, client service, or office operations role

● Writes clearly and warmly. Our clients receive detailed, personal responses, and this person becomes the voice behind them

● Stays organized through constant interruption. Phones ring, emails arrive, and priorities shift within the same hour

● Curious about the whole operation rather than only their own corner of it

● Comfortable learning new software. This seat will live in a new scheduling platform every day

● Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred

● Previous work in building trades or luxury services helpful

**What We Offer**

● Salary $50,000 \+ Performance Bonus

● Comprehensive benefits, including a matching 401K retirement plan

● A clear path to greater responsibility as the company grows

● The opportunity to work with one of New York City's most respected cleaning companies

● A collaborative, tenured team with very little turnover

**Our Values**

Every person here is measured against the same five standards:

Excellence Without Compromise – Accountability at Every Level – Care for Our People, Care for Our Clients – White\-Glove Client Care – Operational Discipline Drives Growth

This company will grow based on our effort and team support.

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

The Standard is one of the most culturally engaged hotels in the world. Hotels with real cultural life, an inclusive spirit and true creative attitude. A destination layered with events and amusements that leaves you with an uplifted feeling.


The Standard's irreverent and playful sensibility, combined with a careful consideration of design, detail and service, have established its reputation as a pioneer of hospitality, travel, dining, nightlife, and beyond. The Standard hotels are known for their taste\-making clientele, their pioneering design, and their unrelenting un\-Standard\-ness.

**Mission Statement**


To create experience by embracing and empowering a diverse collective of team members, collaborators, and guests, who choose to call The Standard home.

**Our Purpose**


The Standard’s commitment is to being an anchor for each neighbourhood in which we reside as well as a platform for culture and creativity. Bringing people together in its spaces to interact with each other in genuine ways.


Our promise is to ensure that a stay is an experience and that a memory means making friends and having stories to tell. To understand why it exists, is to understand that The Standard, is a platform for people to meet, to engage, to learn, to dine, to sleep, to dance, to hideaway, to make believe and to do so whilst being yourself and having fun doing it.


We think of ourselves as a stage, not just a hotel. Here, you can become whomever you like, even if for just a night. Here, you will meet new friends, find new challenges, eat new food, stay up late, sleep in later, and at times, never even leave the property. We are unapologetically comfortable with disrupting expectations.

**It’s WHO WE ARE!**

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad\-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners \- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. jobs.title: Corporate Talent Acquisition Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast\-growing, and high\-performing network of public charter schools takes a village \- families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole\-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

**About the Role**



The Corporate Talent Acquisition Operations Associate owns the administrative infrastructure, data auditing, and tracking systems that keep corporate recruiting running smoothly. This role audits requisitions and candidate data for accuracy, builds and maintains the trackers and tools recruiters and leadership rely on daily, and keeps the ATS clean and current across every open corporate role. It is a hands\-on operations, data, and tools\-building role: the recruiter owns relationships and candidate decisions, the coordinator owns scheduling and logistics, and this role owns ensuring the underlying data, trackers, and processes are accurate, up to date, and built to scale.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Conduct recurring audits of open requisitions and candidate records to catch stale stages, missing data, or SLA gaps, and flag them to the relevant recruiter or TA Manager.
* Build, update, and maintain trackers and dashboards covering pipeline health, req status, SLA compliance, and time\-to\-fill against target OKRs.
* Design and roll out administrative tools and templates (intake forms, tracker templates, comp/leveling checklists) that reduce manual work for recruiters and coordinators.
* Maintain ATS hygiene across all corporate requisitions by correcting statuses and stages and promptly closing out filled or canceled reqs.
* Monitor SLA adherence (scorecard turnaround, onsite\-scheduling windows, offer timelines) and route breaches per the team's escalation framework.
* Prepare recurring reporting packages and ad hoc data pulls for TA leadership, People/HR partners, and compliance requests.
* Document and continuously improve standard operating procedures for recurring TA processes.
* Partner with Recruiters and the Recruiting Coordinator to identify friction points and build the tool or tracker that solves them.
* Support internal audit requests by pulling clean, accurate data on demand.

**Qualifications**


* 2 to 4 years in talent acquisition operations, recruiting coordination, HR operations, or a similar data\- and process\-oriented role.
* Experience supporting multiple stakeholders across a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, with experience building and maintaining trackers, dashboards, or reports from scratch.
* Familiarity with an ATS or recruiting tech stack (Greenhouse, GEM, or similar) and comfort auditing data for accuracy.
* Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Competencies**


* Meticulous \& Detail\-Oriented: Catches data errors and process gaps that others miss.
* Systems\-Minded: Defaults to building a tracker or template rather than solving the same problem manually twice.
* Organized \& Reliable: Keeps multiple trackers, audits, and requests moving without anything slipping.
* Adaptable: Comfortable taking a messy, manual process and turning it into a clean, repeatable tool.
* Proactive: Flags risks and gaps before they become escalations.

**Compensation, Benefits \& Perks**



At Success Academy, we invest boldly in our Network team with a comprehensive package designed to support your health, financial future, and overall well\-being:


* Day\-One Health \& Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting your first day (SA covers 82% of our core medical plan), plus a free One Medical membership and confidential mental health support via EAP/Talkspace.
* Financial Security: 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer match, up to $2,400/year in employer HSA contributions, employer\-paid life/disability insurance, and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligibility.
* Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
* Perks \& Stipends: A $50/month cellphone stipend ($600/year), pre\-tax commuter benefits, backup family care, and performance\-based earning incentives.

This is a hybrid position based out of our NYC Financial District office, requiring on\-site work Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Monday and Friday.


Success Academy Charter Schools is an equal opportunity employer and actively encourages applications from people of all backgrounds. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Success Academy offers a full benefits program and opportunities for professional growth.


**Privacy Policy:**



By providing your phone number, you consent to receive text message updates from Success Academy regarding your application. Reply STOP to unsubscribe. View our Privacy Policy.



We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Front Desk & Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Front Desk \& Administrative Coordinator**

**20–40 Hours per Week \| Upper East Side, Manhattan**

We are seeking an **energetic, socially engaging and proactive Front Desk \& Administrative Coordinator** to support two partner companies, **Active Studios and Self Empowered Minds**, located just around the corner from one another on Manhattan’s Upper East Side.

This is much more than sitting behind a front desk. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys people, brings positive energy into a space, takes initiative, works well as part of a team, and is comfortable helping promote our classes, services, workshops and trainings.

You’ll move between our two nearby locations as needed, helping create a welcoming experience while supporting the administrative, promotional and day\-to\-day needs of both businesses.

What You’ll Do

**Front Desk \& Client/Student Experience**

* Warmly greet students and clients and make them feel welcome
* Check students into classes and maintain accurate attendance
* Answer calls, emails and inquiries
* Assist with scheduling, registrations and appointments
* Maintain welcoming, organized and beautifully presented spaces
* Assist with light cleaning and resetting the spaces as needed
* Help with workshops, trainings and special events

**Administrative Support**

* Handle day\-to\-day administrative tasks
* Maintain organized student/client and scheduling information
* Learn and work with our scheduling and business systems
* Help ensure daily operations run smoothly
* Work collaboratively with instructors, practitioners and other team members

**Promotion, Outreach \& Social Media**

* Follow up with people who have expressed interest in our classes, services, workshops and trainings
* Help turn inquiries into registrations and appointments through warm, personable follow\-up
* Engage with students and clients and make them aware of other services, classes and events they may enjoy
* Actively help promote upcoming programs, workshops and special events
* Create and post social media content
* Take simple photos and videos when appropriate
* Create basic graphics and promotional content; Canva experience is a plus
* Help keep our social media presence active, current and engaging

Who We’re Looking For

We’re especially interested in someone who is:

* **Extremely punctual and dependable** — our students, clients and team rely on the front desk being ready on time
* **Energetic and socially engaging** — someone who genuinely enjoys talking with and getting to know people
* **Proactive** — someone who sees what needs to be done and takes initiative
* **A team player** — willing to jump in and help wherever needed
* Warm, personable and naturally welcoming
* Comfortable promoting services and making recommendations without being pushy
* Organized and able to manage multiple responsibilities
* Professional and discreet
* **Comfortable working in a Mac/Apple environment, including Mac laptops, iPhones and iPads**
* Comfortable learning and working with scheduling systems and other technology
* Comfortable creating and posting social media content
* Able to work independently without needing constant direction
* Interested in wellness, fitness, movement and/or personal development

Schedule \& Position Structure

**20–40 hours per week**

The exact schedule will depend on availability and experience. Some evening and weekend availability is important because our classes, workshops and trainings take place throughout the week.

This position will initially be structured as a **1099 independent contractor position**, with the potential to transition to a W\-2 employee position in the future. As a 1099 independent contractor, you are responsible for your own tax withholding and tax obligations.

About the Position

This position supports **Active Studios and Self Empowered Minds, two partner companies located just around the corner from one another on the Upper East Side.**

jobs.title: Junior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Hey there!
  

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?



Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.


As part of the Fever Originals team, you will use data and insights to create one\-of\-a\-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments.


**Who you'll work with**  

  

You will join one of our offices around the world to work in teams and directly interact with our partners, providers, and venues.  

  

In this role you will help Fever grow its pipeline of original events. To do so, you will interact with all departments of Fever, from Marketing to Operations.  

  

The team you're about to join consists of people that are motivated, young, and fun. On top of having multicultural backgrounds, people in the team are all top profiles: McKinsey, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, and Roland Garros.



Employees are expected to be in the office Monday to Thursday with possibility to work from home on Fridays.  

  

**What you'll do**  

  

**As a Project Manager, you will work with your team lead to develop, launch and manage your events, from A to Z. Together with the other departments, you will define the way to scale this event to all our other markets.**  

**You will be responsible for owning the strategic planning, execution, and reporting for our key strategic scalable experiences.**

  


When you join Fever, you are joining a company that will invest in your professional development. You will receive training and coaching on how to:


* **Provide a detailed analysis of business opportunities and inefficiencies; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high\-quality experiences are delivered.**
* Work with the Fever marketing team to make sure events make an impact: both in terms of ticket sales and coverage
* Manage, report on, and grow revenue from scalable events
* Grow the scalable experiences against team targets
* Help to scale the events to our other cities through developing and sharing best practices (opportunity for travel)
* Foster and grow the Fever Partner Network: including venues and event organizers
* Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, work with product/engineering to deliver on themRepresent Fever at local events and with local PR
  


**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 1\+ years in a project management role or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background.
* Fluent English.
* Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You will also have strong analytical, relationship management, and organizational skills.
* You'll be solution\-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions.
* You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.
* Highly organized and efficient
* Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts
* Great networking skills and the ability to make smart partnerships happen
* Able to communicate with events partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
* Ability to think strategically when faced with an events partnership brief or with our proprietary data on what events work
* Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work\-streams
* Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
* Knowledge of promotional tools such as Facebook and Instagram is a plus
* Strong academic background is a plus


You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble and learn and can work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

  

**What you'll get**


* Opportunity to have a real impact in a high\-growth global category leader
* Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance (total compensation of around 70\-75k)
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Gympass Memberships
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
* Work in a location in the heart of Manhattan
* Responsibility from day one with strong opportunities for professional growth
* Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!


**Our hiring process**


* A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit and answer any questions you may have
* A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics and written understanding
* A 30 min interview with your future manager

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
***Key Responsibilities***

  

ISI Markets is looking for an experienced Sell\-Side Account Manager to manage, retain and grow a portfolio of institutional clients across the global financial markets.

  

This is a commercially focused role with significant opportunity to expand existing relationships and drive adoption of ISI’s market\-leading fund flow intelligence, macroeconomic data, research and analytics.

 ***What you’ll do***

  

* Own a portfolio of sell\-side client relationships, acting as the primary commercial contact.
* Build trusted relationships across research, strategy, economics, sales \& trading, capital markets, quantitative research and data teams.
* Drive renewals, retention, upsell and cross\-sell, identifying whitespace across clients, geographies and use cases.
* Leverage ISI’s established sell\-side relationships to uncover new revenue opportunities and expand adoption across the wider organisation.
* Partner with Product Sales Specialists and internal teams to develop account strategies and deliver growth.
* Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients identify new applications for ISI’s data across research, market intelligence, client engagement and capital markets workflows.
* Proactively manage renewal risk, commercial negotiations and account forecasting.
* Represent the voice of the client internally, sharing market feedback and opportunities with Product and GTM teams.

  


***Experience \& Skills***

  

* Proven experience in sell\-side account management, client success or relationship management, ideally within financial data, SaaS, research or B2B information services.
* Strong understanding of how investment banks, broker\-dealers or research providers use data and analytics.
* Demonstrated success growing relationships and identifying cross\-sell and expansion opportunities within complex financial institutions.
* Credibility engaging with senior stakeholders including analysts, strategists, economists, quants and sales leaders.
* Strong commercial mindset with a track record of delivering retention and revenue growth.
* Excellent communication, presentation and relationship\-building skills.
* Genuine interest in financial markets, investor behaviour, fund flows, capital allocation and macroeconomic trends.
* Experience with Salesforce and other CRM/reporting tools.
* Understanding of APIs, data feeds and cloud delivery models is advantageous.
* Additional languages are desirable.
* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in economics, finance, business, mathematics or a related discipline preferred.

  



***About ISI Markets Group***

  



ISI Markets Group is a leading provider of data, research and intelligence focused on the world's fastest\-growing and highest\-potential markets. We provide the intelligence and tools that inform confident strategic, investment and risk decisions for our clients worldwide.

  

For more information visit **isimarkets.com**

  


***Working for Us***

  



ISI Markets is an ambitious and growing group, headquartered in London, with over 750 experts across a network of 20 offices worldwide, serving customers in 70 countries. We ensure that our culture enables our people to have a meaningful and rewarding career chapter with us:

  


* **Stronger Together:** You will be part of a collaborative dynamic global sales team of 150 professionals.
* **Rewarding High Performance:** We offer competitive reward and commission structures as well as quarterly sales awards for our highest performers.
* **Inclusive Environment:** We believe our diversity is what helps us to win with over 40 nationalities represented amongst our global team.
* **Innovation:** We value fresh perspectives and expect our people to contribute and share their views.
* **Career Growth Opportunities:** We invest in our people through ongoing training and have a strong track record of promotion from within.
* **Hybrid Working:** We promote hybrid working in all of our offices and trust our employees to do their best work irrespective of where they are working.

  


***Equal Opportunity***

  

ISI Markets is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Account Manager plays a critical role in owning and advancing B2B relationships within the largest and most complex healthcare delivery networks, including health systems (HSs), Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), state CDC awardees, major health departments, and other large institutional accounts. Serving as the primary customer liaison, this role engages HCPs, senior\-level clinical and non\-clinical stakeholders to understand customer priorities, address unmet needs, and deliver customized, data\-driven value propositions.


The Account Manager is responsible for meeting or exceeding sales goals within an assigned territory by developing and executing a comprehensive territory and key account business plan aligned to brand strategy. This position requires the ability to confidently deliver approved scientific and clinical information to healthcare professionals, drive appropriate product utilization within approved indications, and effectively leverage organizational resources to optimize customer engagement.


Success is measured by strong account launch performance, consistent achievement of sales objectives, and sustained customer partnership development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer \& Account Management**

* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with large, organized customers, including IDNs, academic medical centers, and key decision\-makers (e.g., CMOs, Pharmacy Directors, Infectious Disease Specialists, and P\&T Committee members).
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, aligning customer needs with GSK’s brand strategy and value proposition.
* Identify and engage key clinical and non\-clinical influencers within healthcare delivery networks to ensure optimal account penetration and access.
* Discover and develop other stakeholders within key clinics and accounts.

**Sales Performance \& Territory Execution**

* Achieve and exceed sales targets by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated business plan for assigned territories and key accounts.
* Plan and prioritize activities to meet call metrics, optimizing coverage and frequency across top target customers.
* Analyze regional and local market trends to establish short\- and long\-term sales goals and inform a robust business and launch strategy.
* Manage territory budgets to effectively support sales and marketing activities.

**Clinical \& Product Expertise**

* Deliver compelling, compliant clinical brand presentations to physicians, advanced practice providers (APPs), medical staff, and appropriate clinic personnel.
* Maintain strong knowledge of assigned products, disease states, competitors, and evolving healthcare landscapes.
* Understand the internal dynamics of healthcare delivery systems, including physician hierarchies, pharmacy workflows, and nursing roles.

**Collaboration, Reporting \& Compliance**

* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Regional Sales Directors, brand teams, and internal partners to enhance territory performance and a customer experience.
* Provide insights and feedback on marketing strategies and sales effectiveness.
* Complete administrative tasks accurately and on time while executing brand strategy within the assigned geography.
* Participate in ongoing training and professional development.
* Maintain full compliance with all corporate, legal, regulatory, and industry policies.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field
* Ability to travel up to 50%, including overnight stays (based on district size)
* 3–5 years of biotech or pharmaceutical sales experience **required**
* Hepatology or Specialty sales experience **strongly preferred**
* Proven success in product launches and achieving sales targets
* Demonstrated expertise in account\-based selling and managing complex sales processes
* Strong understanding of health system business models, organizational structures, and decision\-making processes (e.g., formulary, P\&T)
* Experience engaging C\-suite and director\-level stakeholders within large healthcare delivery networks
* Ability to lead through influence in a highly matrixed organization
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data and trends into actionable business plans
* Excellent presentation, selling, and communication skills
* Strong business acumen and customer\-focused mindset
* Demonstrated commitment to compliance and ethical standards
* Flexibility, adaptability, and a passion for improving patient outcomes
* Fluency in Mandarin, Cantonese, Korean, Vietnamese or Tagalog preferred
* Valid driver’s license


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $170,000\-180,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better

jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



The ad sales team is responsible for the advertising vision, development and growth of our largest advertising partnerships. This team is seeking additional team members to build an industry\-leading ads and promotions business across DoorDash's core category, enterprise restaurant brands. The growing DoorDash ads business will quickly become the single best place for merchants and brands to market to local customers, in an ecosystem that benefits all parties.



You'll leverage AI\-powered insights, data\-driven signals, and emerging tools to shape strategy, inform decision\-making, identify opportunities, and drive growth across complex, enterprise\-level engagements. By integrating AI and data\-enabled analysis into day\-to\-day workflows, you'll improve prioritization, execution, and business impact while partnering cross\-functionally to translate evolving platform and AI capabilities into clear, tangible value for partners and the business.


**About the Role**
------------------



The Account Manager, Enterprise Ad Sales role will steer the company's efforts in adopting and partnering with major Restaurants across our strategic portfolio of merchants. You will build partnerships that create tangible value for both DoorDash and advertisers. In this role, you will manage the ads \& promos strategy across a focused portfolio of accounts, and drive adoption of our growing ads and promotions offering with a keen focus on intra\-quarter upsells and optimization of campaigns. You will also work cross\-functionally with marketing, analytics, and product to innovate on our future approach and solutions. You will report into the Head of Ad Sales in our Enterprise Sales \& Business Development organization.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Be part of the growing DoorDash Ads \& Promos team
* Facilitate end\-to\-end marketing conversations across a portfolio of restaurant advertisers with an emphasis on optimizations and upsells
* Oversee the tactical execution with our largest partners
* Steer the development, adoption and scaling of Restaurant ads \& promos products
* Build a marketing calendar with restaurant partners in your book of business
* Develop long\-term business plans alongside your Account Executive and our partners for their digital growth strategies
* Create marketing campaigns; own post\-campaign reporting
* Optimize and upsell based on performance against advertiser KPIs
* Work with partners across DoorDash to align companywide resources to help build\-out our partners' digital businesses

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You are a detail oriented account manager with 6\+ years of experience in digital media

Impact Motivated * \- You have a natural desire to improve the overall business

Curious * \- You love digging into low levels of detail to extract insights

Strategic * \- You love to find the win\-win in novel agreement structures to grow business with partners

Diverse * \- You are happy juggling many priorities concurrently
* Bachelor's degree required, MBA or Masters Degree a plus
* Business Development and Partnerships experience
* Experience with Analytics and Presentation tools
* You have proficiency in analytics and visualization tools

  



Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only



We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. * Experience leveraging data, AI\-informed insights, and emerging AI tools to drive strategic decisions, enhance productivity, and improve outcomes in complex business environments.
* Strong ability to interpret AI\-generated insights, synthesize them into clear, actionable recommendations and executive\-level narratives, and influence stakeholders.
* Baseline fluency in AI concepts, with a willingness to continuously learn and adopt new technologies as AI capabilities become increasingly embedded in workflows, products, and customer interactions.

**About DoorDash**
------------------

jobs.title: Arterial Account Manager - New York Metro - Peripheral Vascular
jobs.description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.
Are you a strategic, clinically savvy sales professional passionate about driving meaningful impact in vascular care? Join us as an **Arterial Account Manager**, where you’ll operate with autonomy, lead program development, and partner with top physicians and health system leaders to bring life‑changing PAD and CLTI therapies to more patients.


In this high‑visibility role, you’ll collaborate across specialties—including interventionalists, vascular surgeons, service line leadership, and internal cross‑functional teams—to develop, launch, and scale PAD and LimFlow programs. You will also work closely with local Account Managers and Field Clinical Specialists to accelerate adoption and drive growth.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify new growth opportunities and uncover unmet clinical needs within PAD and CLTI patient populations.
* Build alignment with multidisciplinary stakeholders, including physician champions and hospital leadership.
* Drive therapy adoption through clinical expertise, education, and program‑building initiatives.
* Create demand and expand access to the Artix and LimFlow portfolios to grow long‑term franchise value.
* Execute coordinated strategies with VTE Account Managers using shared targets, aligned messaging, and real\-time field insights.
* Deliver high‑impact presentations outlining clinical and financial benefits of the portfolio to physicians and hospital administration.
* Provide valuable product feedback to R\&D and Marketing, serving as a key clinical voice for innovation.
* Represent the company at trade shows, conferences, and educational events.
* Act as a clinical subject matter expert during national calls and training programs.
* Partner with Sales Leadership and Medical Education to support new hire onboarding and ongoing training needs.
* Develop and disseminate insights to internal stakeholders during pre‑sale and evaluation processes.
* Perform other responsibilities as needed to support regional and national initiatives.

**What You Bring**

**Skills \& Abilities**

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong MS Office skills (PowerPoint, Excel, reporting).
* Exceptional presentation skills—from 1:1 settings to large audiences.
* Clinical excellence and comfort in case‑based environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Proven leadership and the ability to educate and develop others.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Passion for delivering patient‑focused, team‑based healthcare solutions.
* Robust sales and business acumen.
* Strong communication habits using company systems and tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science degree in a related field.
* Minimum 6 years of medical device field sales experience.
* Current certifications and vendor credentials.
* Demonstrated history of consistent quota attainment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* At least **2 years of experience with Stryker or Inari** sales/clinical (preferred).
* Previous experience in the **peripheral arterial space**.

**Why This Role Matters**


This is a unique opportunity to shape programs, lead strategic initiatives, and be at the forefront of innovation in PAD and CLTI care. If you thrive in clinically oriented environments, love building partnerships, and want to make a lasting impact on patient outcomes — we’d love to talk.

  

Base \+ commission: $125,000\.00 and may be eligible to earn commission and/or bonuses \+ benefits.


Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD\&D insurance, and short\-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

jobs.title: Confirmed Account Manager
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.


Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.


Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.


At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We’re customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

  

As a Confirmed Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.


By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.


This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota\-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross\-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add\-on SKUs, and build deep, long\-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.


Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market\-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.


**This is a hybrid role based in NYC.**


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Own NRR: Manage the full post\-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
* Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
* Target Strategically: Prioritize high\-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long\-term growth plans.
* Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
* Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi\-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision\-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
* Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head\-to\-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
* Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
* Manage Pipeline \& Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data\-driven NRR forecasting.
* Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.
  

### **Qualifications:**


* Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
* Customer\-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
* Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
* Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
* Analytical, detail\-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
* Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long\-term value through partnership.
* Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next\-generation AI\-powered communications platform.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

  

**The Role**
------------


As a Mid Market Account Manager, you will own gross dollar retention and drive growth across your book of business. You will be responsible for running renewal cycles, prospecting within your existing accounts to identify expansion opportunities, and upselling and cross selling throughout your book of business. This includes discovery with executives, proving ROI and value, and partnering with CSMs who manage risk and adoption at the end\-user level.

  

You will work closely with your CSM counterpart but own the commercial relationship. **Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

Talkspace is the world's leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele\-health. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
**Why Join GEICO?**


At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

  

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

  

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

**About the Role:**


Within Product Marketing at GEICO, the digital funnel is where marketing investment either converts or doesn't. This role exists to understand exactly why — and to fix it.


The Digital Marketing Manager, Product Marketing analyzes performance across owned digital channels and the online funnel, identifying where conversion is breaking down, diagnosing root causes, and partnering with Engineering on experiment design and testing to drive improvement. A core part of the role is owning the full ad\-to\-application view: connecting how traffic from performance media and organic channels behaves on\-site, understanding the Martech and measurement ecosystem that enables that view, partnering with SEO/AEO on discoverability and on\-site optimization, and working with Creative on landing page optimization. The output is a single, coherent picture of the digital funnel — and a prioritized, cross\-functional agenda for improving it. The role is also hands\-on day to day: making page\-level content and layout edits directly in the CMS in close collaboration with Creative, SEO and Engineering.


This role requires someone with proven, hands\-on experience in digital analytics and conversion optimization — not just familiarity with the tools, but a track record of diagnosing funnel problems, understanding how Martech and measurement systems shape the data, and driving measurable improvement through experimentation and cross\-functional partnership.

**How We Work:**


The Marketing organization at GEICO is guided by a clear set of principles: we hire the best at every level and invest in developing them. We believe that strategy comes before action — if we don't know why we're doing something, we don't do it. We bring the same care and accountability to how we spend resources as we would if it were our own business. And when there are challenges, we face them directly and collectively. Leaders in this organization are expected to bring that same mindset to their teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Funnel \& Experience Analysis**

* Review the online funnel end\-to\-end — from ad click through completed application — to identify gaps, drop\-off points, and conversion opportunities
* Independently analyze site, funnel, and business performance using analytics tools and operational data
* Identify trends, diagnose root causes, and distinguish between experience issues, traffic quality issues, and execution issues
* Communicate the expected impact of marketing investment changes on site metrics, giving stakeholders a clear before/after view

**Marketing Spend \& Traffic Translation**

* Understand traffic composition by marketing channel (paid search, paid social, affiliate, organic) and how each channel's traffic behaves on\-site
* Translate channel\-level spend and traffic characteristics into expected site performance benchmarks by source
* Surface where upstream channel quality and downstream site metrics tell different stories, and propose experience optimizations tied to how different traffic sources actually behave
* Work closely with Marketing Analytics and channel owners to understand campaign optimizations, traffic mix changes, and their downstream impact on funnel performance

**SEO/AEO, Landing Page Optimization \& CMS Execution**

* Partner with SEO/AEO teams to align on\-site content, structure, and technical performance with organic search and answer\-engine discoverability goals
* Analyze landing page performance by traffic source and campaign, identifying where messaging, layout, or performance is limiting conversion
* Partner with Creative and Engineering to test and refine landing page concepts, translating performance findings into clear briefs and iteration recommendations
* Make hands\-on updates directly in the CMS — copy, imagery, and page\-level layout changes — in collaboration with Creative and Engineering; this is working\-level execution, not ownership of CMS strategy, architecture, or governance

**Experimentation \& Engineering Partnership**

* Partner with Engineering to design, scope, and prioritize experiments aimed at improving funnel and conversion performance
* Maintain visibility across all active site experiments — tracked, monitored, and read out consistently
* Generate and follow the data to propose UX and funnel testing that improves the quote and application experience

**Reporting \& Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a daily power user of dashboards (Power BI or similar), using them to understand funnel health, traffic performance, SEO/AEO, and experiment status at both a macro business level and a micro diagnostic level
* Leverage SQL, Snowflake, or similar platforms to construct BI reports and uncover digital conversion gaps

jobs.title: Order and Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Job Title: Order and Production Coordinator  
Company: Indigo Promotions  
Location: North Bergen, NJ, In Person  
Job Type: Full Time  
Experience Level: Entry Level  
Compensation: $18\.00 to $20\.00 per hour

About Indigo Promotions:

Indigo Promotions is a minority\-owned branded merchandise company that creates custom products, apparel, packaging, event giveaways, and corporate gifting programs for leading global brands. We manage creative, deadline\-driven projects through domestic suppliers, overseas factories, and our in\-house production capabilities.

Position Overview:

Indigo Promotions is seeking an organized, dependable, and highly detail\-oriented Order and Production Coordinator to join our team.

This is an entry\-level position with hands\-on training provided. You will learn how to create purchase orders, communicate with suppliers and factories, monitor production schedules, review order details, and help ensure projects are completed accurately and delivered on time.

The goal is for this person to gradually take ownership of the production coordination process for an assigned group of clients. No promotional products experience is required, but you must be organized, comfortable following detailed processes, and willing to take responsibility for keeping projects on track.

Responsibilities:

* Create purchase orders with accurate pricing, quantities, product specifications, artwork instructions, shipping information, and delivery dates.
* Communicate regularly with domestic suppliers and overseas factories to request updates and keep orders moving.
* Monitor production schedules and confirm that projects remain on track for their required delivery dates.
* Request and organize virtual proofs, product samples, production photos, tracking information, and shipping documents.
* Carefully review purchase orders, proofs, and production details for accuracy before orders move forward.
* Track projects from the time an order is placed through production, shipping, and final delivery.
* Keep CommonSku and internal project trackers updated with accurate order information.
* Notify the team immediately about potential delays, inventory problems, artwork concerns, or production issues.
* Help coordinate solutions when an order encounters a production or shipping problem.
* Maintain clear records of factory conversations, approvals, deadlines, and project updates.
* Learn Indigo Promotions’ production procedures and gradually take ownership of assigned orders and client projects.
* Assist with estimates, sales orders, invoices, and client presentations when needed.
* Handle additional production and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications and Skills:

* This is an entry\-level position, and previous promotional products or production experience is not required.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to review information carefully.
* Excellent organization and time\-management skills.
* Clear and professional written communication.
* Ability to follow established procedures while learning when to ask questions or escalate an issue.
* Comfortable managing several assignments and deadlines at the same time.
* Dependable, responsive, and willing to follow through until a task is completed.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities may change.
* Basic proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Docs.
* Willingness to learn CommonSku and other order\-management tools.
* Experience in customer service, administration, purchasing, logistics, project coordination, or order processing is helpful but not required.
* Experience communicating with vendors or working across international time zones is a plus.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn from feedback.

Training and Growth:

The Order and Production Coordinator will receive hands\-on training in Indigo Promotions’ systems, supplier relationships, order\-management procedures, and production processes.

The successful candidate will begin by supporting existing production workflows and learning alongside an experienced team member. As their knowledge and confidence grow, they will be expected to independently manage purchase orders, supplier communication, production schedules, and delivery tracking for assigned projects.

Schedule Expectations:

This is a full\-time, in\-person position. Because Indigo Promotions works with overseas factories and manages time\-sensitive projects, occasional communication outside standard business hours may be required. This is not a 24\-hour on\-call position, but flexibility may be needed when an urgent production matter arises.

Additional Information:

Indigo Promotions is an equal opportunity employer offering competitive compensation, hands\-on training, and opportunities for professional growth.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone beginning their career who wants to develop practical experience in production, purchasing, operations, logistics, and branded merchandise.

To apply, please submit your resume directly to ethan@indigopromos.com.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative
jobs.description:
The Territory Sales Representative closes sales through face\-to\-face interaction with customers based within assigned sales territories. They meet with potential and existing customers to present sales proposals and inform them of product benefits and features. The Territory Sales Representative will play a key role in increasing distribution and display activity by managing and negotiating with clients, research sales competition, qualifying prospects and managing sales of products and services.

  

We offer: Job Stability, Set Schedule, Team Setting, Paid Time Off and Benefits

**Bonus: You will be eligible for a bonus of $1500 after 6 months of continuous active employment, and an additional $1500 after 1 year of continuous active employment**

* High School Diploma or GED or equivalent experience required

* Must possess good problem\-solving skills
* Must be able to use an iPad/Tablet
* Must have trip planning skills and comfort with driving a commercial van (Ford Transit Connect or similar)
* Sales or consumer goods experience a plus

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

**A Better Built World**
------------------------


At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
#### **Sales Development Representative**
**New York City**


#### **Who We Are**



In today's economy, an increasing number of workers are choosing to freelance. By 2027, half the U.S. workforce will be independent contractors. Yet there is no system of record for this vast self\-employed community and the legions of businesses that increasingly rely on it. A new paradigm is needed to accommodate the future of work that is suddenly no longer in the future. That is what Wingspan is building.



Wingspan is the AI\-native platform for the flexible workforce. Our agents run onboarding and verification, manage work and pay, bill and stay compliant, and support workers on one record, across 1099 contractors, international contractors, and flexible W\-2 employees.



We're a Series B startup based in NYC with backing from some of the best VCs and operators around, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Touring Capital, and the CEOs and founders of Warby Parker, Harry's, Allbirds, Invision, and Flatiron Health.



Now we're hiring for you: an ambitious individual ready to help build, design, and take us to the next level.



Are you ready to be part of a team redefining the future of work? Apply now!


#### **Impact of the Role**


* As a Sales Development Representative, you'll play a crucial role in breaking into new accounts across all levels of our target customer segments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives, conduct market research to identify potential customers and leads, and qualify those leads.
* Drive Wingspan's outbound prospecting motion, generating sales leads that turn into opportunities and closed business.
* Demonstrate your ability to be a tenacious self\-starter every day as you advance your career.
* Educate and develop leads through outbound prospecting via phone calls, videos, emails, and events.
* Generate email sequences and make cold calls to map and penetrate accounts.
* Conduct follow\-up calls and emails until meetings are set.

#### **Qualifications**


* Available to work in our New York City office 3–4 days per week.
* You are an active communicator who collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to consistently improve processes and communication.
* Previous SDR/BDR or sales internship experience is a plus.
* Experience in a fast\-growing startup and/or in the HR or payments space is a plus.

#### **Requirements**


* **No prior SDR experience is required.** Recent college graduates and candidates with sales or similar internships, or entrepreneurial experience, are encouraged to apply.
* You have an entrepreneurial mindset and enjoy building and testing new processes.
* You are adaptable and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.
* You are extremely organized and a diligent note\-taker.

#### **Compensation**



At Wingspan, we pride ourselves on offering a competitive and comprehensive compensation package that reflects our commitment to attracting top talent. This role pays a **$65,000 annual base salary with $85,000 annual on\-target earnings** ($65,000 base plus $20,000 variable at target) and is accompanied by a target equity package and an extensive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance. All figures cited are in USD and pertain to workers located in the United States.


#### **Benefits \& Perks**


* Unlimited vacation
* Competitive stock option package
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Top\-of\-the\-line Mac laptop
* 401(k) matching
* Wellhub gym membership


**We appreciate candidates who are open and honest about what they're looking for so we can ensure it's a fit on both sides.**



Wingspan does not accept agency\-provided resumes from recruitment firms we do not partner with, and any unsolicited resumes sent to our job\-related emails or staff will not result in charges to Wingspan.



At Wingspan, we are an equal opportunity employer passionately dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We wholeheartedly believe that embracing diversity of perspectives and backgrounds is essential to building the best products and providing delightful experiences for our users and team members. We are proud to maintain an environment free from discrimination, retaliation, and harassment.



All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, ancestry, ethnicity, marital status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law or ordinance. As we strive for excellence, we are committed to ensuring fair employment practices and business dealings and rejecting any form of discrimination or retaliation. These protections and commitments extend to all management practices and decisions, including recruitment and hiring, appraisal systems, promotions, training, and career development programs. Consistent with these obligations, Wingspan also provides reasonable accommodations to employees and applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs, observances, and practices.



If you would like to request an accommodation as part of the application process, please contact Jake Hansen at jakeh@wingspan.app.



Join us in our mission to create a company and products we love, as we celebrate our diverse workforce and promote an inclusive work environment that drives innovation and success.

------------


New York, NY (HQ)


**Employment Type**

Full time


**Location Type**

Hybrid

Business Development


**Compensation**

* $85K – $105K • Offers Equity

The final compensation will depend on the location and level at which the candidate is hired.


  
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.


**About the Role**
------------------


Ramp’s Sales organization is looking for self\-motivated teammates who are excited to learn the craft of outbound selling and help accelerate our growth. As an SMB Sales Development Representative, you will be an early point of contact for prospective customers by researching, engaging, and qualifying finance leaders at growing businesses.


This is a foundational sales role for early\-career talent. You will build prospecting, discovery, messaging, and account\-prioritization skills through structured training, coaching, feedback, and repetition.


**What You’ll Do**
------------------


* Source new sales opportunities through inbound qualification and outbound outreach.
* Research companies, prioritize accounts, and identify the right prospects to contact.
* Build thoughtful phone, email, and multi\-channel campaigns that create relevant conversations with finance leaders.
* Qualify prospects through consultative discovery and uncover business challenges before positioning Ramp.
* Clearly explain how Ramp can help finance teams simplify spend management, reduce manual work, and gain visibility and control.
* Maintain accurate prospect and activity data in Salesforce and other sales tools.
* Use AI and other tools thoughtfully to improve research, personalization, and workflow efficiency; validate outputs before using them.
* Use coaching, data, and feedback to improve performance and contribute qualified pipeline.

**What You’ll Need**
--------------------


* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and concisely.
* Curiosity about business challenges and how finance teams operate.
* Comfort in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment that includes repetition, feedback, and rejection.
* A builder mindset: you spot friction, create simple improvements, learn from results, and adapt quickly.
* Demonstrated coachability and willingness to ask for help, practice, and improve.
* Practical AI fluency and sound judgment when using tools to improve work quality and speed.
* A genuine interest in beginning a sales career and building foundational outbound skills.

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------


* Customer\-facing, sales, fundraising, service, or leadership experience.
* Experience working toward goals, metrics, or performance targets.
* Familiarity with CRM, outreach, or productivity tools.
* Exposure to a high\-growth or ambiguous environment.
* Interest in finance operations, spend management, or B2B technology.

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**
----------------------------------------------------------------


* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------


* 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------


* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

**United Kingdom**
------------------


* Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite
* Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi
* Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

**Referral Instructions**
-------------------------


If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

  

**Other notices**
-----------------


Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

  

*Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.*

jobs.description:
Title: Research Coordinator


Location: Upper East Side


Org Unit: Research


Work Days: Monday\-Friday


Weekly Hours: 35\.00


Exemption Status: Exempt


Salary Range: $68,200\.00 \- $77,500\.00


* As required under NYC Human Rights Law Int 1208\-2018 \- Salary range for this role when Hired for NYC Offices


**Position Summary**
--------------------



Under direction, monitors all data management, regulatory and financial aspects of clinical trial operations. This role also coordinates special research projects, prepares internal board protocols for clinical research, assists in the design of evaluation tools/instruments and coordinates budgets.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Develops and implements practices to ensure research efficiency by routinely analyzing and evaluating workflow.
* Coordinates the collection, compilation, documentation and analysis of clinical research data from various clinical sites. Assists in the determination of guidelines for the collection of clinical data and or administration of clinical studies.
* Ensures compliance of general and study specific regulatory related processes with SOPs, FDA, NIH, and applicable regulations for the reporting of events to regulatory agencies.
* Develops regulatory reports and associated documentation in accordance with SOPs and study specific processes.
* Prepares study related budgets for granting agencies. Negotiates study related budgets with various sites, departments and sponsors.
* Researches and develops the recruitment strategies. Employs modeling and simulation tools to understand the current and projected outcome of recruitment techniques. Monitors and evaluates the success of varying subject recruitment techniques.
* Participates in protocol development as it relates to patient recruitment. Assesses, analyzes, prepares and submits departmental protocols to various places as it relates to subject recruitment and retention.
* Performs monitoring visits: pre\-study, initiation, routine monitoring and closeout visits.
* Works closely with sponsor, site and study personnel on relevant regulatory issues. Develops policies and procedures pertaining to regulatory and monitoring processes. Leads regulatory educational training events for personnel at various sites.
* Maintains inventory of supplies, equipment and/or reagents. May order supplies/equipment/reagents as authorized or ensure that needs are escalated appropriately. Receives supply orders and confirms accuracy of delivery. May assist with cost control.
* Performs other related duties as directed.
**Education**
-------------


* Bachelor's Degree in related field
**Experience**
--------------


Approximately 2 years of experience in health\-related role, in clinical or research setting**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
-----------------------------------


* Experience with conducting and carrying out protocols and research coordination.
* Familiarity with IRB interaction, regulatory policies, database input and report generation.
* Research experience in an academic health center with exposure to a team research environment at all levels (senior investigators, nurses, research coordinators, lab technicians).
**Licenses and Certifications**
-------------------------------


**Working Conditions/Physical Demands**
---------------------------------------


Standard office work
