jobs.description:
**ABOUT NEW SETTLEMENT**


The Crenulated Company Ltd. dba New Settlement Apartments (“New Settlement”) is a community\-led, mission\-driven settlement house rooted in the Bronx. For more than 35 years, New Settlement has worked with youth, families, residents, and community members in the Southwest Bronx to build resilience, expand opportunity, and strengthen neighborhoods through after\-school education and youth development, workforce development and college readiness, health, fitness, and wellness programming, community organizing for better housing and safer schools, and arts, creative expression, and community\-building initiatives.


Rooted in the Bronx, New Settlement stands with community members to break systemic barriers, advance justice, promote leadership, and strengthen neighborhoods. By ensuring agency around education, employment, housing, wellness, and creative expression, New Settlement helps cultivate an equitable society where individuals and families have the power to use their voice to create the change they wish to see.

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Content Specialist will be responsible for supporting the Program Director for a school\-based after\-school program funded by the Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD) To provide specialized instructional services and academic support to students in the designated content area. The Content Specialist will report to and be supervised by the Program Director, focusing on activity design and implementation.


We are seeking a qualified Content Specialist with a strong commitment to youth development to work in our comprehensive year\-round Youth Development Centers (after\-school, holiday, and summer camp programs). The Content Specialist will ensure that staff are providing/facilitating fun and engaging activities with a focus on: Academic Support; Leadership Development; Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math (STEAM); Literacy; Healthy Living; Life Skills; and Physical Activity.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Create and design age\-appropriate lesson plans for participants. Collect, review and provide feedback on all lesson plans to ensure proper alignment with Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD) and NYCPS standards.
* Develop instructional materials to support participants in improving comprehension and retention of specific subject matter, while strengthening academic skills in targeted areas.
* Identify participants who are struggling with course material and provide individualized support, encouragement, and alternative approaches to enhance understanding.
* Work collaboratively with the Program Director, Assistant Director, and school staff to align instructional support with academic expectations and develop activities, assignments, practice tests, and learning strategies that support student achievement.
* Provide coaching and guidance on classroom management techniques and other areas f professional development.
* Create or use curriculum tools to support curriculum integrity and develop academic learning plans for participants.
* Encourage participants’ motivation, confidence and positive attitudes toward learning by recognizing their efforts, progress, and achievements.
* Ensure the health, safety, and well\-being of participants by providing appropriate supervision at all times.
* Create and maintain a consistent strength\-based, youth\-focused environment that is responsive to participants with learning, emotional, or behavioral differences.
* Maintain accurate program documentation, including attendance, sign\-in/sign\-out forms, behavior reports, incident reports, and accident reports, as appropriate.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with parents and guardians through regular communication about their child’s strengths, progress, and areas of growth.
* Comply with all Department of Health (DOH), New Settlement, and DYCD standards, expectations, and regulations.
* Perform other duties or special projects as assigned by the Program Director, authorized designee.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Education, Childhood Development, Sociology, Psychology, or related field required
* Minimum of three (3\) years of experience working with youth (elementary or middle school\-aged/based experience a plus).
* Minimum of one (1\) year of experience supervising staff.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, multi\-tasking, time management, and communication skills required.
* Experience working with school\-age youth and youth of diverse backgrounds preferred.
* Knowledge of youth development principles, such as Social Emotional Learning (SEL) a plus.
* Excellent communication skills and a willingness to take initiative and manage tasks while working in a multi\-faceted, busy environment.
* Ability to motivate participants to participate in activities which focus on Academic Support, Leadership Development, Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math (STEM), Literacy, Healthy Living, and Physical Recreation.
* Must be able to attend occasional morning, evening, or weekend meetings and/or trainings.
* Must have a commitment to work from a strength\-based and/or youth development perspective.
* Must be able to work holidays as needed.
* Must possess the ability to maintain confidentiality and use appropriate discretion.

**About Contineo Group**

Welcome to Contineo Group! If you are looking for a workplace that feels like a true community, you've found it. We foster a culture built on trust, flexibility, and the courage to think for ourselves. Our compass guides everything we do: **Show Up, Connect. Deliver.** We believe in lifting you up, clearing the path forward, and providing a supportive space for you to grow into your full potential. Around here, people always come first, and we take real pride in doing honest work we can stand behind.

**About the Role**

Not all Project Coordinator roles are created equal—and we are looking for someone with a very specific skillset. We are seeking a highly organized Site Development Project Coordinator who understands the unique landscape of civil engineering, land development, and commercial construction. In this role, you will be the organizational backbone of our Project Management team, ensuring the seamless execution of developer\-driven site development projects across retail, industrial, restaurants, multifamily, and golf course sectors.

If you know how to navigate municipal permitting, love diving into due diligence research for potential development sites, and can expertly juggle subconsultant coordination, you are exactly who we are looking for. You will bring order and precision to internal workflows, track critical tasks from project setup through closeout, and ensure our engineers have the support they need to deliver craftsmanship.

**A Quick Note Before You Apply:** To be successful in this role, you must have prior experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or land development industry. We love general project managers, but for this specific seat, we need someone who understands site development lifecycles, due diligence, and permitting!

**What You'll Do (The Day\-to\-Day)**

· Due Diligence \& Research: Act as a research analyst by gathering critical project data, zoning codes, and jurisdictional requirements to help developers and Project Managers assess site viability and scope projects accurately.

· Master the Permitting Process: Navigate the complexities of local jurisdictions. Monitor permitting and submission schedules, coordinate document deliveries/retrievals, and keep projects moving through the approval gauntlet.

· Subconsultant Coordination: Manage the moving parts by coordinating with external partners (surveyors, geotechnical engineers, environmental consultants, traffic experts). Ensure subconsultant agreements are completed, named, and stored properly.

· Project Tracking \& Scheduling: Own the project logistics. Use Smartsheet and other tracking tools to monitor deadlines, milestones, and project progress. Assist with scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, and compiling follow\-up action items.

· Document Management: Create initial project folders, maintain proposal content archives, and ensure all contract documents and internal forms are organized. Assist in organizing final deliverables and project closeout documentation.

· Cross\-Functional Support: Review and provide guidance on client invoices, track proposal statuses, and assist in compiling documentation for case studies or marketing use.

**What You Bring to the Table**

**Your Experience \& Technical Toolbox:**

· 2–4 years of project coordination experience specifically within Civil Engineering, Architecture, Land Development, or Commercial Construction (Required).

· Proven experience assisting with site due diligence, permitting processes, and subconsultant coordination.

· Strong working knowledge of digital collaboration platforms (Smartsheet and Google Workspace are heavily utilized here).

· Exceptional file organization, version control habits, and task\-level proficiency in document management tools.

**Your Mindset:**

· You are a master of organization and genuinely detail\-oriented—nothing slips through the cracks on your watch.

· You are a clear, prompt communicator with a team\-oriented support mindset.

· You thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility to handle varied tasks while under the direction of Project Managers.

· You are self\-accountable, proactive, and take immense pride in supporting a team that delivers high\-quality work.

**Why Choose Contineo?**

We promise to show up for you by investing in your growth and well\-being. In return, we ask that you show up for our clients and our team with precision and intent. Here’s how we support your health, financial security, and personal well\-being:

· Health \& Wellness: Medical, Dental, \& Vision insurance, Mental Health Resources, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Long\-Term Disability, and Lactation Accommodation.

· Growth \& Family: Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Holidays, Paid Parental \& Maternity Leave, Tuition Reimbursement, real Mentorship \& Coaching, and a Robust Online LMS.

· Financial \& Civic: Competitive Salary, 401(k) Matching, Workers' Compensation, Jury Duty \& Voting Leave, and Military \& Personal Leave.

Description:  



**Position Purpose**
====================


The Start\-Up \& Commissioning Project Coordinator is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, documentation, and field execution required to start, test, verify, and turn over HVAC and mechanical systems on assigned projects. Success in this role requires anticipating commissioning needs, coordinating technicians and trade partners, resolving deficiencies, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring systems are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements.


This position works closely with Project Managers, Project Executives, field leadership, controls, service/start\-up technicians, subcontractors, vendors, commissioning agents, engineers, and customers to remove obstacles and drive projects from construction completion through functional testing, owner acceptance, and turnover.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Develop and maintain a clear start\-up and commissioning plan that aligns with the project schedule and turnover milestones.
* Keep start\-up technicians, vendors, controls, and field teams coordinated so equipment and systems are ready when needed.
* Identify, track, and drive resolution of deficiencies that could delay testing, commissioning, or owner acceptance.
* Maintain complete, accurate start\-up, testing, commissioning, and turnover documentation.
* Build strong working relationships with project teams, commissioning agents, engineers, vendors, and customers while protecting Maxair’s interests.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Operational Leadership**
--------------------------

* Plan and coordinate equipment start\-up, pre\-functional checks, functional performance testing, and commissioning activities for assigned projects.
* Develop look\-ahead schedules and manpower plans for start\-up and commissioning activities in coordination with the project schedule.
* Confirm systems are ready for start\-up by coordinating completion of installation, power, controls, piping, ductwork, TAB prerequisites, and manufacturer requirements.
* Coordinate factory\-authorized representatives, vendors, subcontractors, controls providers, TAB contractors, and internal technicians.
* Track equipment status, deficiencies, punch\-list items, retesting, and completion dates; escalate issues before they affect milestones.
* Review plans, specifications, submittals, sequences of operation, and commissioning requirements to understand testing and turnover obligations.
* Maintain start\-up reports, checklists, commissioning forms, test records, deficiency logs, and project completion documentation.

**People Leadership**
---------------------

* Set clear daily and weekly priorities for start\-up and commissioning personnel and provide timely direction and feedback.
* Promote safe work practices, quality workmanship, accountability, and professional communication during testing and turnover activities.
* Support the development of technicians and field leaders by sharing system knowledge, lessons learned, and commissioning best practices.

**Customer \& Business Leadership**
-----------------------------------

* Communicate proactively with Project Managers, customers, commissioning agents, engineers, and field leaders regarding status, risks, deficiencies, and upcoming testing needs.
* Represent Maxair professionally during commissioning meetings, inspections, functional testing, and owner demonstrations.
* Coordinate warranty/start\-up issues and ensure open items are assigned, documented, and driven to closure.
* Support project closeout by helping ensure required training, O\&M information, test documentation, and commissioning records are complete.
* Make timely decisions that protect schedule, quality, customer relationships, and project profitability.

  

Requirements:
**Qualifications**
==================

* Strong commercial HVAC/mechanical systems experience, including equipment start\-up, controls, and system operation.
* Working knowledge of HVAC equipment, hydronic systems, air systems, controls sequences, and commissioning processes.
* Ability to read construction drawings, specifications, submittals, control diagrams, and sequences of operation.
* Strong planning, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple trades, vendors, technicians, and project stakeholders under changing field conditions.
* OSHA 30 Certification and valid driver’s license required based on company standards.
* Proficiency with Excel, Word, Outlook, project management/job cost software, and electronic commissioning documentation.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================


Successful Start\-Up \& Commissioning Project Coordinators consistently plan ahead, communicate clearly, hold themselves and others accountable, collaborate across departments and trades, make sound decisions under changing conditions, and build trust through reliable follow\-through. They take ownership of system readiness and turnover, surface problems early, and drive issues to closure while reflecting Maxair’s Core Values every day.

Description:
**U.S. Soccer Overview**


The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good.


We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S.

  

U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision\-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results.

**Soccer Forward Overview**


Soccer Forward is U.S. Soccer’s social impact and legacy initiative, created to harness the power of soccer to improve lives and strengthen communities across the country. Launched in the lead\-up to the 2026 FIFA Men’s World Cup, Soccer Forward is focused on ensuring the impact of this moment extends well beyond the tournament by creating greater access and opportunity to experience, play and participate in the game.


Through programs, partnerships and community\-based activations, Soccer Forward brings together organizations from across the soccer ecosystem, U.S. Soccer partners and donors, and national and local community organizations to create meaningful and lasting impact. By connecting U.S. Soccer’s reach and resources with organizations already doing important work in communities, Soccer Forward helps expand access to the game, strengthen the people and places that make soccer possible, and use the sport as a vehicle for positive change.


The Soccer Forward team develops and delivers thoughtful social impact strategies, programs and events that bring Soccer Forward’s priorities to life in communities across the country. Through community\-based activations, key U.S. Soccer moments and partner\-supported events, the team creates meaningful opportunities to expand access to the game, increase participation and strengthen communities. The team works closely with U.S. Soccer’s sponsors, media partners and donors to integrate their priorities into this work in authentic and impactful ways, while building and managing relationships with community organizations, U.S. Soccer members and other key stakeholders across the soccer ecosystem.

The Research Coordinator will support the delivery of key research initiatives led by the Kang Women’s Institute, with a focus on improving female health, performance, and participation in soccer.


Working with researchers, industry partners, practitioners and governing bodies, this role will help ensure the successful execution of the Kang Women’s Institute’s research agenda. * Support the synthesis and communication of research findings through reports, presentations, and ecosystem\-facing content.
* Support the development of a centralized women's sport science data repository.
* Manage internal and external reporting processes to ensure key stakeholders are updated on research progress.

**About Us**
------------

  

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.


**About Georgia Tech**
  

Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.


**Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**
  

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:


1\. Students are our top priority.
  

2\. We strive for excellence.
  

3\. We thrive on diversity.
  

4\. We celebrate collaboration.
  

5\. We champion innovation.
  

6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  

7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  

8\. We act ethically.


9\. We are responsible stewards.


Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.


**About the School of Civil \& Environmental Engineering at the Georgia Institute of Technology**
  

The School of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Georgia Tech currently has over 650 undergraduate students, nearly 320 graduate students, 55 tenure\-track faculty members, and 4 Professors of the Practice. Women comprise 50% of the undergraduate population, and more than 29% of the undergraduate student population identifies as a member of under\-represented minority groups. Thirteen faculty members are women, and eight faculty members identify as a member of under\-represented minority groups. Twenty\-six faculty members hold endowed chairs or professorships with 30% of them being women faculty. The School's Strategic Vision is available at www.ce.gatech.edu/strategic\-vision. The 2026 U.S. News and World Report rankings place the Civil Engineering undergraduate program at \#2 and the Environmental Engineering undergraduate program at \#1 in the country. The corresponding graduate programs are ranked \#3 and \#4, respectively.


We are a vibrant and intellectually diverse School, with people who are using new technologies to expand the notion of what it means to be civil and environmental engineers in the 21st Century. We teach our students the engineering fundamentals needed to be successful at the interface of the built and the natural worlds. Our program focuses on learning how to think, how to solve problems, and how to impact society for the better. We provide rigorous learning environments, together with out\-of\-the\-classroom and overseas experiences challenging our students to reach their highest potential.

jobs.title: Construction Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Quick Snapshot**


The Construction Sales Account Manager (CSAM) will cover the Atlanta area and candidates must be local. This position is a combo hunter / farmer, meaning you will be responsible for new business (hunting) as well as retention of existing accounts (farming), ***with a heavy emphasis on hunting (in\-person cold calling and prospecting for new business).*** Prior outside / field sales experience in a construction setting will be preferred.

 **Job Summary**  

The Account Manager \- Construction Sales is responsible for managing waste and recycling services for existing construction accounts and growing temporary revenue by meeting or exceeding monthly sales goals. Account management includes handling service requests and service issues, educating customers and prospects on proper recycling processes, as well as the capabilities of WM's on\-line tools. Focus on new business activities of 70% or greater is expected. New business activities include growing existing customer relationships, receiving referrals, and cold calling on new/planned construction projects.  

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**  



* Managing business to business sales relationships
* Developing detailed proposals encompassing multiple services
* Researching aspects of the waste and environmental services business
* Attending conferences/symposiums as a means of networking and staying current with industry\-and market\-related information
* Assignment management
* Building trusting relationships
* Providing high\-impact Communication
* Responsible for prospecting and closing to achieve budgeted sales goals by developing and implementing sound selling strategies that ensure revenue growth
* Manage prospects by developing sound marketing plans and maintaining key information in the prospect database
* Matches WM services with customer needs by demonstrating knowledge of customers, pricing and competition; effectively communicates pricing and service strategies; proactively engages other WM business opportunities, referring internally as appropriate
* Effectively use WM sales productivity software tools (i.e. Prospect and Customer Database, Proposal Program, Pricing Tools, etc.)
* Proposes customer solutions that are compliant with appropriate local, state and federal regulations
* Devising sales approaches and solutions
* Marshalling resources
* Sales negotiation
* Sales opportunity analysis

 **Qualifications**  

  

Required Qualifications  

  



* Bachelor's Degree (accredited) or in lieu of degree
* High School Diploma or GED (accredited) and 4 years of relevant work experience.
* 1 year of relevant work experience in direct business\-to\-business sales, and phone based business\-to\-business prospecting resulting in successfully obtaining customer appointments (in addition to education requirement)
* 20 hours of training with Resource Conservation and recovery Act (RCRA) and
* Certifications: WM CRA and
* Involved in one or more of the following: U.S. green Build council (USGBC), American Institute of Architects (AIA), Associated general Contractors of America (AGC), Building Owners and Managers Association (BOMA), or National Association of Home Builders

 **Physical Requirements**  

  

Listed below are key points regarding physical demands, physical and occupational risks, and the work environment of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.  

  

Normal setting for this job is: outside / field sales visiting local construction sites.

 **Benefits**  

At WM, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and short\-term disability. In addition, we offer a stock purchase plan, company matching on a 401(k), and more. Employees also receive paid vacation, holidays, and personal days. Please note that benefits may vary by site.  

  



If this sounds like the opportunity that you have been looking for, please click Apply.

**HAWQUE PROTECTION GROUP****JOB DESCRIPTION \- CONCIERGE ACCOUNT MANAGER**

  

Position Title

  

Security Concierge Account Manager

Division Manager

Full\-Time

$20\-$25 per hour

 **Position Overview**


The Concierge Account Manager is a field\-based operations leadership role responsible for supervising, scaling, and standardizing concierge\-style security operations across multiple client locations. The role owns service quality, post order compliance, staffing stability, training consistency, and client satisfaction across the assigned concierge portfolio.


The Security Concierge Account Manager serves as the primary leader for onsite Concierge Leads and ensures every site operates consistently through coaching, audits, performance management, and strong client relationships.


During the initial launch and pilot phase of the division, this position is expected to actively work onsite at varying locations approximately one to two days per week to support process mapping, operational design, training execution, and service standard implementation. Following successful scale and operational consistency within the Atlanta market, the position will transition into a more traditional field operations account management structure with oversight responsibilities focused exclusively on concierge clients and teams.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **Concierge Leadership Across Multiple Sites:** Own day\-to\-day execution and performance across the concierge security portfolio. Establish operational standards for appearance, customer experience, access control, reporting quality, and professionalism. Ensure each site maintains clear coverage plans, escalation procedures, and shift leadership consistency. Drive operational accountability and service excellence across locations.
* **Leadership \& Team Development:** Lead and manage onsite Security Concierge Leads as direct reports. Hold leaders accountable to measurable performance expectations and operational standards. Deliver coaching, recognition, corrective action, and performance management when appropriate. Conduct recurring check\-ins and maintain documented action plans and follow\-up. Ensure leads effectively train and develop their teams beyond routine site visits.
* **Quality Assurance \& Compliance:** Conduct scheduled and surprise site audits to ensure post order compliance. Review daily activity reports, incident reports, operational logs, and site documentation. Identify recurring concerns and implement corrective action plans with ownership and timelines. Ensure licensing and compliance requirements are consistently maintained.
* **Client Relationship Management:** Serve as the primary operational point of contact for property management and client stakeholders. Attend client meetings and manage service concerns proactively and professionally. Communicate operational updates, staffing risks, incidents, and improvement initiatives. Maintain a service culture aligned with luxury hospitality expectations.
* **Staffing \& Coverage Ownership:** Partner with Scheduling and Recruiting to maintain staffing consistency. Develop and maintain bench plans for call\-offs, peak demand periods, and emergency coverage. Coordinate staffing escalations and coverage approvals when necessary. Reduce turnover through strong leadership, accountability, and development.
* **Training \& Onboarding:** Own onboarding and readiness of new Concierge Leads. Standardize training related to front desk etiquette, access control procedures, de\-escalation techniques, and reporting standards. Implement repeatable coaching tools, checklists, scripts, and shift briefing processes. Ensure refresher training occurs consistently and is documented.
* **Reporting \& Performance Management:** Track performance metrics and provide trend reporting to leadership. Maintain documentation for coaching, policy concerns, and corrective action plans. Deliver weekly and monthly operational summaries. Support incident investigations and after\-action reviews.
 **Work Environment \& Schedule**


This is a field\-based position requiring frequent travel between assigned client sites. Evening, weekend, and after\-hours support may be required depending on staffing needs, client meetings, audits, incident response, or operational escalations.

 **Key Performance Metrics**

* Client satisfaction and retention
* Site audit and post order compliance performance
* Staffing stability and attendance outcomes
* Incident reporting quality and timeliness
* Reduction in recurring operational issues
* Concierge Lead effectiveness and operational consistency
 **First 60\-Day Success Targets**

* Building strong relationships with property management teams and onsite Concierge Leads
* Implementing clear operating standards across sites
* Improving audit performance and reporting quality
* Stabilizing staffing and reducing recurring coverage gaps
* Ensuring Concierge Leads operate independently and consistently

At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world—making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact.
  
  

Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose — as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.
  
  

If you are a highly motivated and tenacious individual looking to grow your career in a business\-to\-business (B2B) sales environment, we have a great opportunity for you!
  
  

Our Business Development Representative (BDR) team plays a key role within our broader Sales organization bringing new business opportunities to life! As a BDR, you will be driving new business growth by identifying and creating opportunities in untapped markets through proactive and strategic outbound prospecting and building a strong pipeline that leads to successful deals closed. You’ll connect with diverse B2B prospects, develop deep expertise in the risk and compliance industry, and sharpen your skills to persist, overcome challenges, and deliver results.
  
  

This is a role for a competitive self\-starter who has a hunger to win, creates momentum, is resilient and stays relentlessly focused on achieving your goals. Accelerate your impact and unlock exciting opportunities to further your career growth in Sales with our team!
  
  

You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to your success. Join us and help shape what’s next!
  
  

**What you’ll get:**  

* Meaningful Purpose. Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people—at a scale few companies can match.
* High\-Performance Environment. We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* Candid, Supportive Culture. We communicate openly, challenge ideas—not people—and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* Growth That Matters. You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* Rewards for Results. We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.


**What you’ll do:**  

* Compete to win and exceed your monthly quota by maintaining high call activity and quickly assessing a prospect’s “fit”
* Proactively generate qualified leads by cold calling, engaging with and developing prospects for the Sales team to close
* Document, track and monitor all leads and activities in Salesforce.com
* Utilize smart, targeted questions to speak knowledgeably with decision makers such as VPs, Directors and C\-suite personnel
* Acquire in depth knowledge of our full range of risk and compliance solutions and services, conveying that knowledge to potential customers, and adhering to company messaging and positioning
* Nurture relationships with longer term prospects
* Conduct territory development best practices with email, phone and chat using sales enablement tools to connect with new prospects and current customers


**What you’ll bring:**  

* Previous sales, telemarketing or lead generation experience; cloud computing or SaaS industry experience preferred
* A tenacious work ethic with a desire to have a career in sales
* Competitive drive, a hunger to win and a self\-starter mindset—you create opportunities, take ownership, and stay focused on results to meet and exceed quota monthly, maintain a high call rate and quickly assess prospect’s “fit”
* Grit and know\-how with a curious and creative mindset to set goals to achieve bigger outcomes
* Technical acumen to ramp up quickly on core technologies such as Salesforce, Groove, etc.
* A modest yet assertive and confident demeanor with empathy and compassion
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills, presentations skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives to engage and influence executive\-level decision makers
* Culture Agility. Comfort working in a fast\-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow\-through
* AI Readiness. Curiosity and willingness to use AI and emerging technologies to elevate your work and deliver smarter outcomes
* Fuel performance and outcomes. Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values


**Our side of the deal:**  

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* On\-Target Earnings of $70,000 per year. The starting pay for this role is $24\.04 per hour and the target variable pay for this role is $20,000\. Target variable pay is based on individual achievement factors and is not guaranteed. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

**Service Sales Representative**


Cana Communications, an Eagle Fire\-owned company, has helped protect people and property through life safety systems since 1982\. We provide fire alarm, security, communications, and other low\-voltage solutions tailored to the needs of the facilities we serve.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary and commission plan

* Paid time off and 10 paid holidays
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company\-paid life insurance
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance
* 401(k) with company matching

**Position Overview**


The Service Sales Representative grows service revenue and develops lasting customer relationships across Cana Communications’ fire, life safety, and low\-voltage solutions.


This position manages the complete sales cycle for inspection, maintenance, repair, and recurring service opportunities—from prospecting and customer discovery through proposal development, follow\-up, and close. The Service Sales Representative works closely with operations, estimating, and technical teams to develop solutions that are accurate, competitive, and operationally achievable.

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and execute territory and account plans that support assigned revenue, margin, and growth goals.
* Build a balanced pipeline of inspection, maintenance, repair, and recurring service opportunities.
* Generate new business through prospecting, referrals, networking, customer outreach, and market research.
* Develop trusted customer relationships by understanding each customer’s facilities, systems, compliance requirements, service history, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer meetings and site visits to identify needs, recommend solutions, and uncover opportunities to expand existing relationships.
* Prepare and present accurate proposals and quotations for fire alarm, low\-voltage, inspection, maintenance, repair, and service work.

* Partner with operations, estimating, and technical resources to confirm scope, labor, materials, pricing, scheduling considerations, and operational capacity before making commitments.

* Coordinate the handoff of sold work to operations, ensuring that scope, pricing, documentation, scheduling information, and customer expectations are clearly communicated.
* Remain engaged as needed during service delivery to support a positive customer experience and the timely resolution of concerns.
* Represent Cana Communications / Eagle Fire at customer events, trade shows, association meetings, product demonstrations, and other business\-development activities.
* Maintain knowledge of company capabilities, applicable industry requirements, market conditions, and competitive offerings through ongoing sales, product, technical, code, and systems training.

**What Success Looks Like**


The successful candidate is a consultative and disciplined sales professional who:

* Listens to understand customers’ operational, technical, and compliance needs before recommending a solution.
* Consistently prospects, follows up, and maintains an accurate sales pipeline.
* Can understand technical information and explain solutions clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Considers scope accuracy, pricing, margin, operational capacity, and long\-term account value.
* Collaborates effectively with sales, estimating, operations, and technical teams.
* Takes ownership of commitments and remains engaged through the successful customer handoff.

**Qualifications**

* Two to five years of successful sales experience involving low\-voltage systems, fire alarm systems, technical services, facility solutions, or a comparable service\-based offering.
* Demonstrated ability to develop customer relationships, manage a sales pipeline, prepare proposals, and close business.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, specifications, and scopes of work to prepare accurate quotations.
* Strong presentation, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with standard business applications and CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
* Ability to travel within the assigned market, including occasional overnight travel.
* Ability to obtain and maintain any licenses or certifications required by applicable national, state, or local requirements.
* Authorization to work in the United States and ability to successfully complete applicable background screening and drug\-testing requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, engineering, marketing, or a related field. Relevant experience and industry knowledge may be considered in place of formal education.
* Experience selling fire alarm, security, CCTV, voice/data, communications, or other low\-voltage systems.
* Familiarity with inspection, maintenance, repair, and recurring service agreements.


In compliance with the Drug\-Free Workplace Act of 1988, we maintain a drug\-free workplace and operate a Drug\-Free Workplace Program.


Cana Communications, an Eagle Fire\-owned company, is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Location: Atlanta, GA, United States

**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Facilities
jobs.description:
The purpose of the project coordinator position is to assist the project manager(s) by providing project support in key areas including assisting in project design; establishing project documentation; maintaining and/or establishing vendor contracts using the Supply Chain process; processing project invoices and monitoring project budget variances. Additionally, the project coordinator may provide project oversight in absence of the project manager. The project coordinator will also manage smaller projects, usually less than 2 – 3 week duration, including managing vendors, customer expectation and the project budget. The project coordinator acts as the department’s SharePoint administrator to ensure all project documentation is scanned and filed appropriately. Strong emphasis is placed on providing a positive response to the concerns and needs of the customer.  



Job Responsibilities  



**Functional Expertise:**

* Manages small projects (usually less than 2\-3 week duration) such as paving or roof repairs/replacements or replacement of mechanical equipment.
* Assists project manager(s) by coordinating proper vendor contracts with Supply Chain to ensure compliance
* Assist project manager(s) by monitoring project spend against established budget and report accrual(s) and appropriate documentation to Accounting, when necessary
* Performs cost analysis and itemizes project budget before composing AFE documentation and submitting for approval;
* Assemble, organize and maintain electronic project documentation via the department’s SharePoint site for future reference

**Business Acumen:**

* Stays abreast of relevant business priorities and changes, and how they affect day to day operations.
* Applies technical knowledge and business experience to solve operational challenges while identifying and escalating appropriate obstacles and issues to project manager.
* Work closely with procurement to develop and evaluate RFP’s that bring strategic partnerships that are competitive in price and present high service levels.

**Engagement:**

* Assists project manager by coordinating large moves outside of headquarters buildings. Coordinates with appropriate management team for optimum move plan.
* Maintains positive relationships with customers and vendors.
* Provides input to management with regards to how projects might affect daily operations, processes or procedures.
* Possesses good verbal and written communication and presentation skills. Is able to express ideas in a clear and concise manner to different levels within the organization.
* Conducts affairs with honesty, integrity, and respect when associating with others, and values the ideas, knowledge, and expertise of others.

**Driving Results** :


* Monitors against metrics and deliverables, holding self and others (vendors) accountable for results.
* Identifies and drives process improvement initiatives, including value engineering items in our construction projects.
* Ensures internal controls are achieved in compliance with corporate policies, procedures and standards.
* Tracks and reports changes that have been identified as having the ability to cause variances in overall project budget.

Qualifications  



**Education, Certifications/Licenses:**

*Required* :  



High school diploma or GED


Or


Equivalent academic education and experience  



**Related Work Experience** :  



*Required:* Minimum 2 – 3 years’ experience in a facilities\-related position


*Preferred* : Experience managing small construction\-related or other projects


Applicant may possess a combination of equivalent education and work experience.  



**Specific Skills \& Knowledge:**

*Required* :


* Strong sense of urgency
* Ability to work closely in a team atmosphere or alone
* Good interpersonal skills
* Excellent communication skills, both orally and in written form
* Intermediate proficiency in MS Excel and Word
* Working knowledge of SharePoint
* Excellent customer service skills
* Must be available to work after hours or weekends for facility moves

*Preferred:* Technical knowledge of building systems including HVAC, plumbing, and electrical  



**Working Conditions/Physical Requirements:**

Keyboarding \= 10%\-20%


On\-call \= none


Travel \= 10%\-20%

The description is not designed to be a comprehensive inventory of duties, responsibilities and qualifications required in the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to qualified disabled individuals for performance of essential duties and responsibilities.*

Southern Company Gas is a wholly owned subsidiary of Atlanta\-based Southern Company (NYSE:SO), America’s premier energy company. Southern Company Gas serves approximately 4\.2 million natural gas utility customers through its regulated distribution companies in four states and approximately 600,000 retail customers through its companies that market natural gas. jobs.description:
Overview:

Symbria works with the Chicago Department of Family and Support Services to deliver Well\-Being classes to older adults. We are looking for students who want to help improve the health and lives of older adults and become certified to deliver Fit \& Strong!, a top ranked evidence\-based exercise program that was developed at UIC. *This is a summer job that has the potential to be a permanent part\-time job in the future.*  

This position is out of **West Town Senior Satellite Center.** **Fit \& Strong! information**: Fit \& Strong! is a group physical activity and behavior change program for persons with arthritis. The program consists of 24 sessions each lasting 90 minutes. The first 60 minutes focus on flexibility, low\-impact aerobics, and strength training to improve lower body function. The remaining 30 minutes consist of health education and group problem solving using a structured curriculum. Participants develop personalized action plans to maintain physical activity and progress after the class ends. Fit \& Strong! is effective, engaging, and fun – the program has high retention and attendance rates.
Fit \& Strong! is currently offered by community sites across 32 states \+ DC. Fit \& Strong! is recommended by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the National Council on Aging, the American Physical Therapy Association, and is a Research Tested Intervention Program evaluated by the National Cancer Institute/NIH.
Read more about Fit \& Strong! here: https://fitandstrong.uic.edu/
Responsibilities:
**Duties:*** Lead evidence\-based group exercise classes for older adults throughout Chicago. Classes are offered in senior centers and senior housing buildings across the City. Promote community outreach well\-being programs during special events.
* Instructors can work between 5 to 25 hours/week, between the hours of 9 AM to 4 PM.
* Instructors may need to travel to multiple sites and different communities throughout the City
* Teaching opportunities are available in both English and Spanish


Qualifications:
**Qualifications:*** Open to current students and graduates with coursework in: kinesiology, exercise science, occupational therapy, physical therapy, nursing, pre\-medicine, and other relevant majors.
* Open to individuals with verified group fitness instructor experience holding a nationally recognized certification (such as ACE, AFAA, or ACSM);
* *CPR Certification Required*


Note: CPR certification can be obtained online through the American Red Cross for $37\. https://www.redcross.org/take\-a\-class/cpr/cpr\-training/cpr\-online ***A******ll applicants will be afforded equal opportunity without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability unrelated to ability, military status or an unfavorable discharge from military service.*** *\#LI\-ONSITE*

The Institute for Population and Precision Health (IPPH), located in the Biological Sciences Division, integrates a wide spectrum of factors such as human health behaviors, environmental factors, social and economic factors, policies and genetic determinants of health, into studies focused on the treatment and prevention of disease, as well as the maintenance of wellness. Leveraging and integrating the University of Chicago’s considerable institutional strength in population science with research spanning diverse fields such as genetic medicine, cancer epidemiology, microbiome, and epigenomics, the Institute will have the common goal of improving human health outcomes. Another major goal of the Institute will be to develop a new multidisciplinary training program to equip researchers with emerging tools and methods to conduct precision health research within a population health framework. Our faculty lead research projects in biostatistics, epidemiology and health services research and participate in interdisciplinary teams with faculty in other departments to address complex problems in health and healthcare, in our communities and around the globe.  

  

**Job Summary**


UChicago is part of a mega\-National Institutes of Health (NIH) program that aims to be the first comprehensive study to investigate precision nutrition. The goal is to develop algorithms to predict individual responses to food and dietary routines. jobs.description:
**Community/Behavioral Health Outreach Coordinator**

**Organization Overview**

American Indian Health Service of Chicago, Inc. (AIHSC) is a federally qualified health center (FQHC) dedicated to providing comprehensive primary care, behavioral health services, case management, and community health education to the Native American community and other underserved populations of Chicago. Our mission is to improve the health and wellness of our community through accessible, high\-quality, and culturally appropriate health care services.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, particularly those with ties to Native American communities.

**Position Overview**

The Outreach Coordinator will support the Behavioral Health team by increasing awareness of available services; providing information and linkage to Behavioral Health services; developing educational and outreach materials; coordinating prevention activities; and strengthening relationships with community members. This role supports clinical staff by helping community members understand available services and connect to appropriate care, while allowing clinical staff to focus on direct patient care. The Outreach Coordinator does not schedule Behavioral Health appointments or make clinical referrals.

The Outreach Coordinator will also facilitate or co\-facilitate non\-clinical psycho\-educational, wellness, and culturally based support groups that promote prevention, resilience, healing, and community connection. AIHSC seeks a dependable, mission\-driven professional who is interested in a long\-term role and committed to building sustained, trusting relationships with community members, patients, partners, and colleagues.

**Scope of Services**

The Outreach Coordinator may provide non\-clinical psycho\-education, wellness support, culturally based support groups, community\-resource information, prevention education, and linkage to care. This position does not provide psychotherapy, clinical counseling, diagnosis, clinical assessment, or independent crisis intervention. When an individual has urgent behavioral health, safety, or crisis needs, the Outreach Coordinator will immediately notify and connect the individual with an appropriately qualified Behavioral Health clinician, supervisor, crisis service, emergency service, or other designated resource in accordance with AIHSC policy.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Community Outreach**

· Represent the Behavioral Health Department at community events, health fairs, powwows, schools, partner agencies, and outreach activities.

· Build trusting relationships with community members through consistent presence and engagement.

· Provide education regarding behavioral health, Substance Use Recovery Services (SURS), crisis resources, suicide prevention, and available community support.

· Conduct outreach activities designed to reduce stigma surrounding behavioral health services.

· Promote behavioral\-health groups, workshops, and community events.

· Conduct outreach to individuals who may benefit from behavioral\-health services and provide information and linkage to appropriate care.

**Groups, Prevention, and Community Programming**

· Facilitate or co\-facilitate non\-clinical psycho\-educational groups focused on wellness, stress management, coping skills, resiliency, healthy relationships, parenting, substance\-use prevention, and life skills.

· Coordinate with the Cultural Committee to support culturally responsive groups that promote healing, cultural identity, community connectedness, and traditional wellness practices.

· Assist Behavioral Health clinicians with community\-based workshops, educational presentations, and prevention programming.

· Monitor and document group attendance through sign\-in sheets, preregistration records, or other approved tracking methods.

**Educational Materials and Community Awareness**

· Assist with the development and distribution of culturally responsive flyers, brochures, and educational handouts.

· Coordinate dissemination of outreach and prevention materials throughout the community.

· Collaborate with the Behavioral Health team to identify educational topics based on emerging community needs and trends.

· Maintain outreach supplies, educational resources, and promotional materials.

**Collaboration, Documentation, and Quality Support**

· Attend Behavioral Health team meetings and assist with planning outreach, prevention, group, and community\-engagement activities.

· Collaborate with Behavioral Health clinicians, community partners, the Cultural Committee, and other AIHSC departments to support coordinated services.

· Document outreach contacts, group attendance, community events, educational materials distributed, linkage\-to\-care activities, and outcomes in approved tracking tools, databases, and/or the EHR, as applicable.

· Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential records in accordance with AIHSC policies, HIPAA requirements, and grant or program reporting requirements.

· Assist with data collection, program evaluation, and reporting activities related to outreach, prevention, and community engagement.

**Education and Experience**

· Associate degree required in human services, behavioral health, social services, public health, community health, education, or a related field.

· An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience in behavioral health, community outreach, peer support, social services, prevention, or community engagement may be considered.

· Experience providing community outreach, behavioral\-health support, social services, community education, peer support, or related services is preferred.

· Experience facilitating educational groups, support groups, or community workshops is preferred.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

**Reports to:** Vice President of Fuels  

**Department:** Fuels / Supply \& Logistics  

  

**Position Summary**  

The Supply \& Logistics Coordinator is responsible for supporting daily fuel supply, logistics, inventory management, reporting, and cost analysis for Road Ranger Travel Centers and potential wholesale customers. This role works closely with suppliers, terminals, common carriers, third\-party logistics providers, internal operations, and the Vice President of Fuels to ensure reliable supply, accurate reporting, efficient deliveries, and cost\-effective fuel sourcing.  

The position also supports ERP/PDI system accuracy, supplier pricing analysis, nightly supply sourcing in a team rotation, executive reporting, and special projects as assigned.  

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities*** Reconcile, analyze, and report daily fuel activity for Road Ranger Travel Centers.
* Develop and maintain weekly and monthly fuel accounting, inventory, logistics, and cost reports.
* Schedule, coordinate, and monitor fuel deliveries for Road Ranger locations and wholesale customers.
* Manage communication and performance coordination with suppliers, terminals, common carriers, and third\-party logistics providers.
* Reconcile and proof carrier freight charges for payment processing documenting deductions due to inaccurate billing and track carrier performance.
* Monitor inventory levels, demand trends, and supply availability to support timely fuel ordering and delivery execution.
* Coordinate and secure fuel supply at various terminals.
* Participate in nightly supply sourcing as part of a Monday through Friday team rotation.
* Assist the Vice President of Fuels with product sourcing, supplier pricing analysis, fuel cost reporting, and supply strategy.
* Support ERP/PDI system setup, improvements, data entry, and ongoing system accuracy.
* Prepare analytics, dashboards, and PowerPoint presentations related to fuel cost, inventory, supplier pricing, logistics performance, and operational activity.
* Support executive\-level and board\-level reporting and presentations as needed.
* Perform special projects and other departmental duties as assigned.
* Maintain confidentiality of company pricing, supply, logistics, and financial information.

**Schedule Requirements**  

Monday through Friday, in\-office, from **1pm to 10p.m.** with some remote working from home optionality. This position also requires participation in nightly supply sourcing rotation. Weekend rotation managing Road Ranger fuels inventory, delivery forecasting, order creation and delivery amendments, and on call for supply issues and common carrier support,  

  

**Education \& Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, transportation, fuel supply, or related operations.
* Experience in general accounting, financial reporting, reconciliation, and business analysis in a corporate environment preferred.

new_jobs.title: Operations & Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**HOLLYWOOD TOYS \& COSTUMES**

6600 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028 \| Serving Hollywood since 1950

**OPERATIONS \& PROJECT COORDINATOR**

**Job type: Part\-time, approximately three days per week. On site. Ongoing position.**

**About the job**

Hollywood Toys \& Costumes is looking for an organized, dependable person to help keep our operations running and to support the person who runs the business day to day. You will keep track of what has been ordered and what has arrived, keep our task list current, keep files and records where people can find them, and help on the sales floor when we are busy.

We are a 75\-year\-old independent shop on the Hollywood Walk of Fame with a very large Halloween season. This is a hands\-on job in a small business. You will be at a desk part of the day and on the floor the rest of it. If you like knowing where everything stands and you do not let things slip, you will do well here.

**What you will do**

* Keep the task list current. Write down what was decided, who is doing it, and when it is due, then follow up on anything still open.
* Track vendor orders: keep the vendor list up to date, note what was ordered, check off what arrives, and follow up on anything late or missing.
* Check invoices against what was ordered and received, and flag anything that does not match before it is paid.
* Keep our spreadsheets current: order history, reorder lists, buy sheets, size breakdowns and inventory counts.
* Enter numbers accurately, sort and filter lists, and use basic formulas to keep the sheets working.
* Keep the manager calendar current, take notes in meetings and write up who agreed to do what, and sort assigned email into the right order.
* Keep digital and paper files organized so vendor records, invoices, contracts and business documents can be found quickly.
* Pull Instagram and TikTok numbers on a set schedule and enter them into the tracking sheet.
* Write down how recurring tasks get done, step by step, so the next person can follow it without asking.
* Help with daily store work: receiving deliveries, counting, tagging, restocking, seasonal floor sets, and helping customers when we are busy.

**What we are looking forRequired**

* Experience in a job where other people depended on you keeping track of details. Retail, office, warehouse, school or similar all count. We care more about how you work than where you worked.
* Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets: entering data accurately, sorting and filtering, and using basic formulas. You will be asked to show us. We will teach you the rest.
* You can keep several things going at once without dropping any of them, and you follow up without being reminded.
* You write clearly and briefly. Short and specific beats long and vague.
* Comfortable with physical work: receiving deliveries, moving and restocking product, and being on your feet when we are busy.
* Reliable in\-person attendance on every scheduled shift. This job cannot be done from home.
* Saturday availability. Saturday is our busiest day of the week.
* Availability for extended hours and weekend coverage between September 15 and November 1, our peak season.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Nice to have, not required**

* Retail, warehouse, receiving or inventory experience.
* You have worked with purchase orders, packing slips or invoices before.
* You have used a task or project tracking tool such as Basecamp, Asana, Trello or Monday. We will train you on ours.
* You have used AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, and you know to check what they give you against the actual document.
* You have written instructions or checklists for other people to follow.

**What makes someone successful here**

* You notice the thing nobody assigned you, and you write it down.
* You would rather ask than guess on anything involving money, a vendor order, or a signed document.
* You are comfortable in a small business where everyone does more than their title says.
* You keep track of a lot of moving parts without losing any of them.

**Schedule**

Part\-time, approximately three days per week, generally fewer than 30 hours. Days and hours vary with the needs of the business and are not guaranteed. Saturday availability is required. Extended hours and weekend coverage are required during our peak season, September 15 through November 1, and pre\-planned time off is not available during that window.

**How to apply**

Apply through this posting, or bring your resume in person to 6600 Hollywood Blvd. Please include short answers to these three questions. We read them, and applications without them are unlikely to move forward.

* Tell us about a time you were responsible for keeping track of a lot of details. What were you keeping track of, and how did you keep it straight?
* Tell us about something at a past job that was slow, messy or confusing. What did you do about it?
* How comfortable are you with Excel or Google Sheets? Give one specific example of something you have made or maintained.

Please also confirm your availability, including Saturdays and our September to November peak season.

**About Hollywood Toys \& Costumes**

For 75 years Hollywood Toys \& Costumes has served tourists, locals and the film industry from the Hollywood Walk of Fame. Consistently named the best costume shop in Los Angeles, we carry one of the widest selections anywhere of adult and children’s costumes, wigs, masks, jewelry, FX makeup, novelties and magic. If you are looking for it, we have probably got it.

6600 Hollywood Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90028

Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly's solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world's largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person's risk of heart attacks.
