new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - Mortgage
new_jobs.description:
**What is Loancrate?**


We started Loancrate to make home\-buying simpler and less expensive for lenders and borrowers. Today, mortgage lenders are stuck running their companies on software products built 20 years ago. These products are slow, unstable, and don't lead to material improvements in efficiency. When using these systems, the average human cost to originate a loan is still over $11,000\.


Loancrate builds AI\-native tooling to automate mortgage workflows. Our ultimate goal is fully automated origination, which has the potential to save lenders over $16B in operating expense per year.


Since starting in 2020, our remote team has enabled our customers to power \>$85 billion in new home loans. We care about collaboration, very open communication covering the good \& the bad so that we learn from our decisions quickly, and ultimately having fun while we're building. You'll fit in well if you like diving deep quickly!

**The Opportunity**


A great loan origination system doesn't sell itself, install itself, or teach itself. It gets adopted because someone on our side sits shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the lender, speaks their language fluently, and knows exactly what a Loan Officer, processor, or team lead is actually trying to do at 4:47pm on a Friday with a rate lock about to expire. We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to be that person.


You'll be the trusted advisor to our lender customers from day one of implementation through long after go\-live. Your job is to help each customer see how their current workflows map into Loancrate, recommend the right way to set things up, answer product questions in real time, handle the inevitable "but we do it this way today" objections, and keep the relationship strong once they're live. You won't be running the project plan \- we have a separate team that owns that \- but you will be the mortgage\-fluent voice in every customer conversation and the reason lenders stay confident, engaged, and moving forward.


Because our product sits at the center of how our customers originate loans, you have to be able to have a real mortgage conversation on day one \- not "learning the space as you go," but already fluent in it. We can teach you the CSM playbook. What we can't do in any reasonable timeframe is teach the depth of mortgage context this role requires.


This is a foundational role. You'll shape how Loancrate advises and supports every customer, help build the playbook that future CSMs will follow, and be one of the loudest voices carrying customer reality back into Product and Engineering. If you've spent years inside a lender in a customer\-facing seat and want to put that expertise toward building something rather than closing files one at a time, this is that opportunity.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the customer relationship from kickoff through go\-live and beyond \- you're the face of Loancrate to your lenders, and the person they call first.
* Advise on implementation from the mortgage seat \- take a lender's current\-system processes, translate them into how Loancrate should be configured, and recommend the setup that will actually work for their business.
* Answer product questions in real time \- from LOs, processors, ops leaders, and executives \- and be fluent enough to do it without a warm handoff.
* Handle objections and keep customers moving \- when a lender pushes back with "this is a hard requirement" or "our other vendor does this today," you're the person who can have that conversation, explain how other lenders solve it, and get to yes.
* Sell the ongoing value of Loancrate through implementation \- implementations can be long, and part of this role is keeping lenders bought in and enthusiastic all the way to go\-live.
* Be the trusted post\-go\-live partner \- you'll already know how the lender is configured, what decisions were made, and why. Once they're live, you stay on as their CSM, their coach, and their first call.
* Be the mortgage voice of the customer internally \- package up requests, edge cases, and pain points into clear feedback for Product and Engineering, and push back thoughtfully when a customer ask isn't the right move.
* Support the sales motion \- as we bring on new customers, help run product demos and speak to prospects in their own language.
* Help build the playbook \- advisory frameworks, common configuration recommendations, objection\-handling guides, and the account artifacts future CSMs will inherit.
* Willingness to travel \- expect approximately once\-a\-month domestic US travel to customer sites, with occasional additional trips around key milestones.

**What Success Looks Like**


Within your first 90 days, you will:

* Be the primary customer\-facing CSM on at least one live lender account, with a clear grasp of their workflows, pain points, and configuration decisions.
* Be trusted by the customer as their go\-to for product and mortgage questions \- not a routing layer, but someone who can actually answer.
* Have shown you can handle a hard customer conversation \- an objection, a pushback, a "we need this or we can't go live" moment \- and move the customer forward.
* Have a direct working relationship with Product and Engineering, with a regular cadence for customer feedback and product questions.


By the 12\-18 month mark, you'll be a trusted operator across your book of business and a candidate to help build and lead the broader Customer Success function as we scale.

**Required Skills and Background**


Direct mortgage lender experience \- you've worked at an actual lender, not only a mortgage tech company, for at least 2\-3 years.


Customer/borrower\-facing experience \- you've been the person on the phone or in the inbox with borrowers and referral partners, not exclusively working behind the scenes on files.


Consultative, sales\-minded instincts \- you're comfortable being persuasive, handling objections, selling against adversity, and pushing back when a cust

new_jobs.description:
Location: East Los Angeles, CA, United States  

Date Updated: Sep 4, 2026  

Job ID: 18078


  
**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Territory \& Strategic Business Planning**

* Develop and execute comprehensive, data\-driven territory business plans aligned to brand strategy and launch objectives.
* Analyze territory data (prescribing trends, account potential, access landscape) to identify growth opportunities and prioritize high\-value targets.
* Manage territory budget responsibly, including speaker programs and promotional initiatives.
* Consistently achieve or exceed sales goals and performance metrics.

**Prescriber Activation \& Clinical Engagement**

* Deliver compelling, compliant, and clinically accurate product education within approved labeling.
* Articulate complex clinical data and value propositions tailored to cardiologists, lipid specialists, endocrinologists, and targeted PCPs.
* Differentiate Arrowhead therapies within a competitive and evolving cardiometabolic landscape.
* Execute speaker programs, educational events, and peer\-to\-peer engagements to drive awareness and adoption.
* Support appropriate patient identification and therapy initiation through thoughtful provider engagement.

**Stakeholder \& Account Management**

* Build and sustain strong, trust\-based relationships with healthcare professionals, office staff, and institutional stakeholders.
* Navigate complex health systems and coordinate effectively within IDNs in partnership with Key Account Managers.
* Identify access barriers and collaborate with Market Access and patient services to support pull\-through.
* Maintain consistent, high\-quality engagement and service across accounts to drive durable utilization.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Health IT, and Patient Services to align territory execution with enterprise strategy.
* Provide actionable field insights regarding market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer feedback.

**Compliance \& Operational Excellence**

* Maintain full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and promotional standards.
* Accurately document field activity and manage CRM reporting in a timely manner.
* Demonstrate disciplined execution, accountability, and ethical conduct in all engagements.

**Travel \& Engagement**

**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

new_jobs.title: Freelance Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced **Freelance Social Media Manager** to support an established Inglewood\-based hair and beauty business.

This is a good fit for someone who can take ownership of the social media function, bring ideas to the table, and keep content moving without needing constant direction. We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for content to be handed to them and posts it.

The right person understands that strong social media content starts with understanding the brand, its audience, communication guidelines, goals, and priorities. You should be able to use that foundation to plan and create content that makes sense for the business.

Most of the work can be completed remotely, but you must be local to the Los Angeles area and available for periodic in\-person content capture in Inglewood, CA.

**This is a 1099 independent contractor opportunity, not an employee position.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and manage monthly content plans that support consistent daily posting across the brand’s social platforms
* Batch\-create and prepare content in advance to maintain a consistent daily content cadence
* Help identify content themes, campaigns, and opportunities that make sense for the brand
* Contribute ideas and recommendations that strengthen the overall social media direction
* Write engaging captions, calls to action, and other social copy that align with the brand’s voice
* Schedule and publish approved content across relevant social platforms
* Repurpose existing photo and video assets into additional social content
* Participate in and help coordinate periodic in\-person content capture in the Los Angeles area
* Help plan what should be captured so content sessions are efficient and produce useful content that can be repurposed
* Organize social media content and digital assets for easy access and reuse
* Monitor content performance and use insights to improve future content
* Stay aware of relevant social media trends and identify the ones that make sense for the brand
* Communicate proactively about content needs, approvals, priorities, and opportunities

**What We’re Looking For**

You should have demonstrated experience managing social media for a business or brand and be comfortable taking meaningful ownership of your work.

The ideal candidate:

* Has professional social media management experience
* Can demonstrate previous work through a portfolio, examples, or relevant accounts
* Understands how brand voice, audience, goals, and positioning should influence content
* Is comfortable developing ideas and making recommendations
* Can work independently while knowing when client input or approval is needed
* Has strong written communication and copywriting skills
* Understands short\-form video and social\-first content
* Is comfortable batching, planning, and scheduling content in advance
* Is organized and able to manage content calendars, deadlines, approvals, and digital assets
* Can interpret basic social media performance data and use it to improve future content
* Is reliable, responsive, and comfortable working directly with a business owner
* Is located in the Los Angeles area and able to attend agreed\-upon in\-person content sessions

*Experience with hair, beauty, lifestyle, or other visually driven consumer brands is a plus, but it’s not required.*

**Experience with social media strategy is also a bonus.** While this role is primarily focused on social media management and execution, we’d love someone who can contribute thoughtful ideas, help shape content direction, and make recommendations based on the brand’s goals and performance.

**This May Not Be a Fit If...**

This opportunity may not be the right fit if your experience is primarily limited to scheduling pre\-created posts, you prefer receiving detailed instructions for every piece of content, or you’re not available for occasional in\-person work in Los Angeles.

We’re looking for someone who can bring strong execution, initiative, creativity, and good judgment to the role.

Pay: $1,200\.00 \- $1,500\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA

Wagan develops and distributes automotive accessories, portable power products, mobile electronics, and related consumer products. We serve retail, wholesale, e\-commerce, and international customers.

We are looking for a proactive B2B Sales Representative who enjoys finding new customers, building relationships, and developing business through phone calls, email outreach, and face\-to\-face visits.

**The Opportunity**

This position will focus on developing new small and midsize business accounts while supporting Wagan’s existing B2B sales activity.

You will prospect independent automotive stores, hardware stores, specialty retailers, distributors, and other businesses that may benefit from carrying Wagan products. You will contact prospective customers, schedule and conduct visits, present samples, follow up on opportunities, and work toward opening recurring accounts.

This is a hands\-on sales role for someone who is comfortable creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound leads. The position combines inside sales, local field sales, account development, and support for selected established accounts.

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and prospect new small and midsize B2B customers.
* Conduct outbound sales activity through telephone calls, personalized emails, and in\-person visits.
* Develop relationships with independent automotive, hardware, specialty retail, wholesale, and distribution accounts.
* Schedule and conduct local customer visits, bringing samples and presenting appropriate Wagan products.
* Qualify prospects, understand their needs, and recommend suitable products.
* Prepare follow\-up materials, pricing requests, samples, and account\-opening information.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospects and active opportunities.
* Follow up reliably until each opportunity reaches a clear outcome.
* Support the Sales Manager with selected B2B, retail, and international accounts.
* Assist with customer meetings, sales presentations, trade shows, and account visits.
* Coordinate internally with operations, customer service, purchasing, accounting, and marketing.
* Maintain accurate notes, activities, next steps, and forecasts in the company’s sales tracking system.
* Learn Wagan’s product lines and communicate their value clearly to customers.
* Provide market feedback on customer needs, competitive products, pricing, and emerging opportunities.
* Help existing smaller accounts grow through regular contact and additional product placements.

new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**  

  

ADT has been in the business of helping save lives since 1874\. As the \#1 smart home security provider in the U.S., we help protect and connect families, businesses and larger commercial customer every day. Our continuous innovation, advanced technology and strategic partnerships deliver products and services that help protect life and valuables, whether at home, your business or on the go. And as times change, so do we.Above all, our mission is clear: we help save lives for a living. Looking for a career where you can make a real impact? Join our team today and put purpose behind your paycheck. \#WeAreADT
*Check out more about life at ADT* here.
**What you should know about our team:**


At ADT, our Sales team is at the heart of everything we do. We’re not just selling security systems, we’re helping protect what matters most. Whether it’s a family home or a small business, our sales professionals are trusted advisors who bring peace of mind to customers across the country.


**What you will do:**


You’ll use your strong communication and creative problem\-solving skills to demonstrate the value of our innovative security and smart business solutions to small business customers while explaining our products and services in depth and recommending the right options for their needs. You’ll work in a dynamic, collaborative environment, partnering closely with business owners, decision\-makers, and teammates. This role involves providing tailored solutions by visiting customers at their businesses. You will:


* Listen and build trust: By showing up with integrity, empathy, and expertise, you’ll become a reliable advisor small business owners can count on throughout the sales process and beyond.
* Customize each system to fit the business’s layout, operations, and security needs, combining security, automation, and life\-safety technology in ways that support how they work.
* Conduct post\-installation follow\-ups with customers to confirm commitments were fulfilled and strengthen long\-term relationships and referrals.
* Cultivate new business opportunities: identify and generate new small business leads within your territory to maximize outreach and growth.

**What you need to be successful:**


We’re looking for self\-motivated, tech\-savvy individuals who are passionate about helping others and driven to succeed. If you thrive on connection, enjoy solving problems, and want to make a real impact while growing your career, you’ll fit right in.


* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Willing to travel within a designated territory using your own vehicle (mileage reimbursed).
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required; additional licensing may be needed based on location.
* Comfortable using technology to stay organized, efficient, and accountable in a fast\-paced sales environment.
* Self\-motivated and results\-driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset; you thrive on uncovering new leads and closing deals that deliver real value.
* Strong communicator and natural relationship builder, able to consult with customers, understand their needs, and guide them to the right solution.
* Adaptable and flexible; you excel in dynamic environments and enjoy learning new systems and approaches.
* Consumer sales experience is preferred but not required.

**How ADT invests in you:**


**Compensation:** Unlimited earning potential with uncapped commissions. Based upon performance, new sales advisors can expect to earn $85,000, while experienced sales advisors can earn over $150,000\.


**Additional Pay:** We equip you with specialized training and the tools you need to meet your financial goals. For your first 8 weeks of training, you’ll earn up to $4,000\.


**Benefits:**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Mileage reimbursement
* Short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, and well\-being programs
* Paid time off
* Culture of professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Flexible work schedule to accommodate you and your customers’ needs
* Click here to view our full benefit offerings.

* We **boldly shape the future**, embracing change, taking smart risks, and continuously improving to create the best experiences.

* We **elevate to serve a greater purpose**, going above and beyond to earn trust, celebrate wins, and value every perspective.

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 6,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to the market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

new_jobs.title: Landscape Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**SGD Enterprises dba Four Seasons Landscaping** is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and hands\-on **Landscape Contract Project Manager** to oversee one of our largest and most complex municipal landscape maintenance contracts in the City of Irvine.

This is a high\-level operational position responsible for the **overall performance, staffing, quality control, reporting, and day\-to\-day execution of the contract**. The Project Manager will serve as the central point of accountability for the project and will work closely with company leadership, field supervisors, irrigation personnel, specialty crews, and City representatives to ensure that all contractual requirements are performed consistently, timely, safely, and to the exceptionally high standards expected by the City of Irvine.

This is **not simply an administrative project\-management position**. The successful candidate must have extensive practical knowledge of commercial landscape maintenance and be capable of walking a property, identifying deficiencies, understanding the appropriate corrective action, directing crews, and verifying that the work has been completed correctly.

Position Overview

The City of Irvine contract encompasses a large portfolio of parks and athletic facilities with extensive turf, athletic fields, landscaped planter areas, irrigation systems, environmental services, specialized turf\-management operations, fertilization, pest management, renovation work, and other technical landscape requirements.

Because of the **size, complexity, visibility, and performance expectations of this contract**, we are looking for a Project Manager who understands landscape maintenance at a professional level and can successfully manage both the people and the technical requirements necessary to deliver an exceptional product.

The ideal candidate will be someone who takes ownership of the project, anticipates problems before they become issues, maintains excellent communication with the City, and holds crews and supervisors accountable for consistently meeting contract specifications.

Key Responsibilities

* Assume overall responsibility for the **successful performance of the City of Irvine landscape maintenance contract**.
* Manage and oversee a large workforce consisting of mowing crews, landscape/detail crews, environmental crews, irrigation technicians, IPM personnel, athletic\-field personnel, supervisors, and specialty turf\-renovation crews.
* Develop and maintain weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual work schedules to ensure that **every contractual requirement is completed within the required service frequency and timeframe**.
* Conduct frequent field inspections throughout the City to evaluate landscape quality, turf conditions, athletic fields, planter areas, irrigation performance, cleanliness, and overall contract compliance.
* Ensure that mowing, edging, detailing, pruning, fertilization, aeration, overseeding, topdressing, turf renovation, irrigation maintenance, pest\-management operations, and other specialized landscape activities are performed correctly.
* Coordinate equipment, vehicles, materials, crews, and subcontractors so work is completed efficiently and without interruption.
* Work directly with supervisors and crew leaders to correct deficiencies and improve productivity and quality.
* Manage employee scheduling, attendance, staffing needs, productivity, training, discipline, and overall field performance.
* Ensure sufficient staffing and equipment are available at all times to meet the City's service requirements.
* Oversee specialized **athletic\-field and sports\-turf maintenance**, including reel mowing, aeration, verticutting, deep\-tine aeration, topdressing, interseeding, turf renovation, fraise mowing, sod preparation, and related operations.
* Work closely with irrigation technicians to ensure irrigation systems are operating properly and repairs are completed promptly.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors for specialized work and material deliveries.
* Review contract specifications regularly and ensure field operations remain in full compliance.
* Prepare, complete, review, and submit **all reports, schedules, documentation, inspection records, work logs, service reports, and other information required by the City**.
* Track corrective\-action requests and ensure issues identified by the City are resolved quickly and documented appropriately.
* Attend meetings and site walks with City representatives and company leadership.
* Maintain professional and proactive communication with City staff.
* Monitor material usage, labor productivity, equipment utilization, and overall project efficiency.
* Assist company management with controlling project costs while **never sacrificing the quality or contractual performance expected by the City**.
* Ensure crews comply with all applicable safety requirements, company procedures, and City standards.
* Maintain accurate records relating to staffing, work performed, additional work, materials, equipment, and contract compliance.
* Recognize potential contractual issues or additional\-work opportunities and immediately communicate them to company management.
* Take complete ownership of the project and ensure that issues are followed through **from identification to final resolution**.

Landscape Knowledge Is Essential

This position requires considerably more landscape expertise than a traditional project\-management role.

The Project Manager must have a strong working understanding of areas including:

* Commercial and municipal landscape maintenance
* Sports\-field and athletic\-turf maintenance
* Reel and rotary mowing practices
* Turfgrass identification and management
* Fertilization programs
* Aeration, verticutting, overseeding and topdressing
* Turf renovation and establishment
* Shrub and groundcover maintenance
* Proper pruning techniques
* Weed identification and control
* Integrated Pest Management
* Irrigation tr

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about crafting compelling digital experiences and driving impactful marketing strategies? We are seeking a dynamic **Digital Marketing Specialist** to join our innovative team! In this role, you will lead the development and execution of comprehensive digital marketing campaigns that elevate brand visibility, boost engagement, and generate measurable results. Your expertise in SEO, paid advertising, content creation, and analytics will be instrumental in shaping our online presence and achieving business objectives. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-paced environment where creativity meets data\-driven decision\-making.

**Duties**

* Develop, implement, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels including SEM (Search Engine Marketing), social media advertising, email marketing, and paid search marketing campaigns.
* Manage and monitor paid advertising campaigns using platforms such as Google Ads (Google AdWords), Facebook Advertising, and other social media advertising tools to maximize ROI.
* Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to enhance organic search rankings; optimize website content for search engines using SEO best practices.
* Create engaging content for websites, blogs, social media platforms, and email campaigns that resonates with target audiences.
* Utilize web analytics reporting tools like Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager to track campaign performance, analyze user behavior, and generate actionable insights.
* Manage website content using content management systems such as WordPress; perform website management tasks including updates, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Design visually appealing graphics and multimedia assets using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite to support marketing initiatives.
* Implement marketing automation strategies to nurture leads and improve conversion rates through personalized messaging.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to coordinate digital campaign setup, testing, and performance marketing efforts aligned with business goals.
* Monitor industry trends in digital marketing to continually refine strategies for social media management, web analytics, paid advertising campaigns, and SEO.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong understanding of SEM, SEO, social media marketing, paid advertising campaign management, and web analytics reporting.
* Proficiency with SEO tools, Google Analytics, Google Ads (Google AdWords), Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation platforms.
* Skilled in content creation with a solid grasp of graphic design tools like Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Hands\-on experience managing websites using WordPress or similar content management systems; familiarity with HTML/CSS is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to manage paid advertising campaigns across multiple channels including Facebook Advertising and Google Ads.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data from web analytics tools to inform strategy adjustments.
* Excellent communication skills for creating compelling content and collaborating effectively with team members.
* Technical proficiency in website management, keyword research, performance marketing tactics, and social media management platforms.
* Knowledge of e\-commerce platforms is advantageous for supporting online sales initiatives.

Join us as a Digital Marketing Specialist where your innovative ideas will shape our digital footprint! Bring your enthusiasm for digital strategy combined with technical expertise — together we’ll create impactful campaigns that drive growth and engagement across all channels!

Pay: $26\.24 \- $28\.93 per hour

Expected hours: 5\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
Part\-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes \| East Bay, CA**  
**Starting at 10\-15 hours/week, with potential to grow to twice that \+**  
**$28\-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people\-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience.

This is a part\-time position to start, with approximately **10\-15 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day\-to\-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the ownership team.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients during active construction
* Communicating clearly, professionally, kindly, and proactively with clients
* Coordinating schedules, materials, deliveries, subcontractors, and jobsite logistics
* Visiting active jobsites to monitor progress, organization, and quality
* Reviewing plans and ensuring the work being built reflects the approved design and scope
* Maintaining high standards for craftsmanship, details, cleanliness, and overall presentation
* Communicating clearly with the field crew and helping resolve questions or issues as they arise
* Identifying potential problems early and helping develop practical solutions
* Keeping projects organized and on track with established scope, schedule, and cost targets
* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication
* Helping coordinate change requests and ensuring work outside the approved scope is properly addressed
* Participating in client meetings, site walks, and project closeouts

You will **not** be responsible for estimating, setting project pricing, budgeting, payroll, or making company financial decisions.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **extremely dependable, organized, communicative, and thoughtful**. You don't need to be a landscape architect or designer, but you do need to understand landscape construction and have a genuine interest in how things are built.

The right person will:

* Have strong practical knowledge of landscape construction, hardscape, irrigation, planting, or related construction
* Be able to read and understand plans and translate them into real\-world construction
* Have exceptionally strong communication skills
* Be comfortable and confident working directly with clients
* Be kind, patient, and professional even and especially when dealing with difficult situations
* Communicate confidently and respectfully with field crews while maintaining clear expectations and a collaborative working relationship
* Have a high standard for craftsmanship and attention to detail
* Notice when something isn't right and be willing to speak up
* Be proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do
* Be highly organized and capable of keeping track of many moving pieces
* Be comfortable taking ownership and following things through to completion
* Understand that the details of the client experience matter just as much as the finished landscape

We are a **small, high\-end boutique landscape design and installation company**, and our clients expect a thoughtful, professional, highly communicative experience. We are looking for someone who naturally understands that standard and can help us maintain it as the company grows.

**Growth \& Training**

This position will begin with approximately **10\-15 hours per week**, with the potential to grow to twice that as responsibilities increase.

Initially, you will **shadow the owner and learn how we manage projects, communicate with clients, work with our crew, and maintain our standards**. As you become familiar with our way of working, you will gradually take on more responsibility for coordinating projects and installations, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination as one of the owners steps back from that role. You will continue to work closely alongside the other owner and our field leadership.

We are looking for someone who is naturally intuitive, observant, and proactive. A good candidate is someone who notices what needs attention, anticipates problems before they become problems, and can often see the next step without having to be told. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills, take on increasing responsibility, and grow with the company over time.

**Why Work With Us**

We are a growing company with a collaborative team culture and a genuine commitment to the people who work with us. We care about doing excellent work, treating people well, and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding our employee benefits and opportunities, including:

* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performance\-based bonuses
* Employee discounts
* PTO
* Opportunities for advancement and increasing responsibility
* A supportive, collaborative team environment
* A company culture that values communication, respect, craftsmanship, and personal growth
* Benefits currently being developed, including a 401(k) with employer matching and healthcare benefits for eligiible candidates

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

Location: Oakland, CA, United States

**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

**Prescriber Activation \& Clinical Engagement**

* Deliver compelling, compliant, and clinically accurate product education within approved labeling.

* Differentiate Arrowhead therapies within a competitive and evolving cardiometabolic landscape.
* Execute speaker programs, educational events, and peer\-to\-peer engagements to drive awareness and adoption.
* Support appropriate patient identification and therapy initiation through thoughtful provider engagement.

**Stakeholder \& Account Management**

* Build and sustain strong, trust\-based relationships with healthcare professionals, office staff, and institutional stakeholders.

* Identify access barriers and collaborate with Market Access and patient services to support pull\-through.

* Partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Health IT, and Patient Services to align territory execution with enterprise strategy.

* Demonstrate disciplined execution, accountability, and ethical conduct in all engagements.

**Travel \& Engagement**

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
At New York's Little Elves, excellence is our reputation. For over 30 years, we've set the platinum standard in fine interior cleaning, trusted by discerning clients, top designers, and architects, and recognized by New York Magazine and Curbed as Best Cleaning Company in New York.

We are seeking an Operations Coordinator to become part of our exceptional team. The Operations Coordinator is the first point of contact for our clients and a central support to our office team. This is a growth position. As we prepare for disciplined expansion over the next 3\-5 years, the person in this role will start by owning our client communications and booking support, and grow into broader operational responsibility as our systems and volume expand.

**About Us**

We specialize in high\-detail housekeeping and post\-construction cleaning for interior designers, architects, and luxury property managers throughout New York City. Our reputation is built on discretion, reliability, and meticulous attention to detail.

We are a small, tenured and welcoming team with over 40 employees on the field. We are a large family, with a strong community \- family culture. We have very little turnover and seek employees with similar priorities.

**Position Overview**

The Operations Coordinator is the front door to New York's Little Elves. This position owns how the office operates day to day, including: first\-line phone coverage, client email correspondence, website inquiries that bring in new work, and supports the booking process that turns those inquiries into scheduled jobs.

This is not a receptionist role. Phones and inbox are where the job begins, not where it ends. The right person will learn how the whole operation runs, take on projects that improve it, and grow with a company that is actively expanding. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail oriented and productive under pressure. Successful candidates thrive in a fast\-pasted environment where priorities shift quickly, are comfortable being friendly and can remain professional under pressure.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Client Communication*

● Answer incoming phone calls as the first point of contact

● Respond to client email correspondence with the care and detail our clients expect

● Manage inquiries submitted through our website

● Document client requests, reschedules, and job changes

*Booking Support*

● Support the booking process from first inquiry through confirmed job

● Gather and verify the details required to quote and schedule work accurately

● Follow up on outstanding inquiries so no request goes unanswered

*Operational Support*

● Work in our scheduling system daily and become the team's most fluent user of it

● Support the supply and inventory function alongside our operations team

● Maintain accurate client records across our systems

*Growth and Improvement*

● Take on defined projects that improve how the office runs

● Identify friction in day\-to\-day processes and bring solutions forward

● Note: Payroll, crew scheduling, and crew assignment remain with our General Manager and President. This role supports the operation; it does not run it.\*

**Qualifications**

● Experience in an administrative, coordination, client service, or office operations role

● Writes clearly and warmly. Our clients receive detailed, personal responses, and this person becomes the voice behind them

● Stays organized through constant interruption. Phones ring, emails arrive, and priorities shift within the same hour

● Curious about the whole operation rather than only their own corner of it

● Comfortable learning new software. This seat will live in a new scheduling platform every day

● Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred

● Previous work in building trades or luxury services helpful

**What We Offer**

● Salary $50,000 \+ Performance Bonus

● Comprehensive benefits, including a matching 401K retirement plan

● A clear path to greater responsibility as the company grows

● The opportunity to work with one of New York City's most respected cleaning companies

● A collaborative, tenured team with very little turnover

**Our Values**

Every person here is measured against the same five standards:

Excellence Without Compromise – Accountability at Every Level – Care for Our People, Care for Our Clients – White\-Glove Client Care – Operational Discipline Drives Growth

This company will grow based on our effort and team support.

Pay: From $50,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Corporate Talent Acquisition Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast\-growing, and high\-performing network of public charter schools takes a village \- families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole\-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

**About the Role**



The Corporate Talent Acquisition Operations Associate owns the administrative infrastructure, data auditing, and tracking systems that keep corporate recruiting running smoothly. This role audits requisitions and candidate data for accuracy, builds and maintains the trackers and tools recruiters and leadership rely on daily, and keeps the ATS clean and current across every open corporate role. It is a hands\-on operations, data, and tools\-building role: the recruiter owns relationships and candidate decisions, the coordinator owns scheduling and logistics, and this role owns ensuring the underlying data, trackers, and processes are accurate, up to date, and built to scale.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Conduct recurring audits of open requisitions and candidate records to catch stale stages, missing data, or SLA gaps, and flag them to the relevant recruiter or TA Manager.
* Build, update, and maintain trackers and dashboards covering pipeline health, req status, SLA compliance, and time\-to\-fill against target OKRs.
* Design and roll out administrative tools and templates (intake forms, tracker templates, comp/leveling checklists) that reduce manual work for recruiters and coordinators.
* Maintain ATS hygiene across all corporate requisitions by correcting statuses and stages and promptly closing out filled or canceled reqs.
* Monitor SLA adherence (scorecard turnaround, onsite\-scheduling windows, offer timelines) and route breaches per the team's escalation framework.
* Prepare recurring reporting packages and ad hoc data pulls for TA leadership, People/HR partners, and compliance requests.
* Document and continuously improve standard operating procedures for recurring TA processes.
* Partner with Recruiters and the Recruiting Coordinator to identify friction points and build the tool or tracker that solves them.
* Support internal audit requests by pulling clean, accurate data on demand.

**Qualifications**


* 2 to 4 years in talent acquisition operations, recruiting coordination, HR operations, or a similar data\- and process\-oriented role.
* Experience supporting multiple stakeholders across a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, with experience building and maintaining trackers, dashboards, or reports from scratch.
* Familiarity with an ATS or recruiting tech stack (Greenhouse, GEM, or similar) and comfort auditing data for accuracy.
* Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Competencies**


* Meticulous \& Detail\-Oriented: Catches data errors and process gaps that others miss.
* Systems\-Minded: Defaults to building a tracker or template rather than solving the same problem manually twice.
* Organized \& Reliable: Keeps multiple trackers, audits, and requests moving without anything slipping.
* Adaptable: Comfortable taking a messy, manual process and turning it into a clean, repeatable tool.
* Proactive: Flags risks and gaps before they become escalations.

* Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
* Perks \& Stipends: A $50/month cellphone stipend ($600/year), pre\-tax commuter benefits, backup family care, and performance\-based earning incentives.

This is a hybrid position based out of our NYC Financial District office, requiring on\-site work Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Monday and Friday.

Serving as the primary customer liaison, this role engages HCPs, senior\-level clinical and non\-clinical stakeholders to understand customer priorities, address unmet needs, and deliver customized, data\-driven value propositions.

This position requires the ability to confidently deliver approved scientific and clinical information to healthcare professionals, drive appropriate product utilization within approved indications, and effectively leverage organizational resources to optimize customer engagement.

* Maintain full compliance with all corporate, legal, regulatory, and industry policies.

* Ability to travel up to 50%, including overnight stays (based on district size)

* Demonstrated expertise in account\-based selling and managing complex sales processes

* Ability to lead through influence in a highly matrixed organization
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data and trends into actionable business plans

* Demonstrated commitment to compliance and ethical standards
* Flexibility, adaptability, and a passion for improving patient outcomes

new_jobs.description:
Location: Manhattan, NY, United States  

Date Updated: Sep 4, 2026

**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT NEW SETTLEMENT**


The Crenulated Company Ltd. dba New Settlement Apartments (“New Settlement”) is a community\-led, mission\-driven settlement house rooted in the Bronx. For more than 35 years, New Settlement has worked with youth, families, residents, and community members in the Southwest Bronx to build resilience, expand opportunity, and strengthen neighborhoods through after\-school education and youth development, workforce development and college readiness, health, fitness, and wellness programming, community organizing for better housing and safer schools, and arts, creative expression, and community\-building initiatives.


Rooted in the Bronx, New Settlement stands with community members to break systemic barriers, advance justice, promote leadership, and strengthen neighborhoods. By ensuring agency around education, employment, housing, wellness, and creative expression, New Settlement helps cultivate an equitable society where individuals and families have the power to use their voice to create the change they wish to see.

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Content Specialist will be responsible for supporting the Program Director for a school\-based after\-school program funded by the Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD) To provide specialized instructional services and academic support to students in the designated content area. The Content Specialist will report to and be supervised by the Program Director, focusing on activity design and implementation.


We are seeking a qualified Content Specialist with a strong commitment to youth development to work in our comprehensive year\-round Youth Development Centers (after\-school, holiday, and summer camp programs). The Content Specialist will ensure that staff are providing/facilitating fun and engaging activities with a focus on: Academic Support; Leadership Development; Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math (STEAM); Literacy; Healthy Living; Life Skills; and Physical Activity.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Create and design age\-appropriate lesson plans for participants. Collect, review and provide feedback on all lesson plans to ensure proper alignment with Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD) and NYCPS standards.
* Develop instructional materials to support participants in improving comprehension and retention of specific subject matter, while strengthening academic skills in targeted areas.
* Identify participants who are struggling with course material and provide individualized support, encouragement, and alternative approaches to enhance understanding.
* Work collaboratively with the Program Director, Assistant Director, and school staff to align instructional support with academic expectations and develop activities, assignments, practice tests, and learning strategies that support student achievement.
* Provide coaching and guidance on classroom management techniques and other areas f professional development.
* Create or use curriculum tools to support curriculum integrity and develop academic learning plans for participants.
* Encourage participants’ motivation, confidence and positive attitudes toward learning by recognizing their efforts, progress, and achievements.
* Ensure the health, safety, and well\-being of participants by providing appropriate supervision at all times.
* Create and maintain a consistent strength\-based, youth\-focused environment that is responsive to participants with learning, emotional, or behavioral differences.
* Maintain accurate program documentation, including attendance, sign\-in/sign\-out forms, behavior reports, incident reports, and accident reports, as appropriate.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with parents and guardians through regular communication about their child’s strengths, progress, and areas of growth.
* Comply with all Department of Health (DOH), New Settlement, and DYCD standards, expectations, and regulations.
* Perform other duties or special projects as assigned by the Program Director, authorized designee.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Education, Childhood Development, Sociology, Psychology, or related field required
* Minimum of three (3\) years of experience working with youth (elementary or middle school\-aged/based experience a plus).
* Minimum of one (1\) year of experience supervising staff.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, multi\-tasking, time management, and communication skills required.
* Experience working with school\-age youth and youth of diverse backgrounds preferred.
* Knowledge of youth development principles, such as Social Emotional Learning (SEL) a plus.
* Excellent communication skills and a willingness to take initiative and manage tasks while working in a multi\-faceted, busy environment.
* Ability to motivate participants to participate in activities which focus on Academic Support, Leadership Development, Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math (STEM), Literacy, Healthy Living, and Physical Recreation.
* Must be able to attend occasional morning, evening, or weekend meetings and/or trainings.
* Must have a commitment to work from a strength\-based and/or youth development perspective.
* Must be able to work holidays as needed.
* Must possess the ability to maintain confidentiality and use appropriate discretion.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY AND POLICY AGAINST DISCRIMINATION AND HARASSMENT**


The Crenulated Company Ltd, dba New Settlement Apartments (New Settlement) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or military or veteran status in accordance with applicable federal laws. Part\-Time (approx. 20 hours/week) \| Mostly Remote Atlanta, GA \| Flexibility for occasional evening or weekend hours

Rally Foundation for Childhood Cancer Research (Rally) a 501 (c) (3\) non\-profit organization, empowers volunteers across the country to raise awareness and funds for childhood cancer research to find better treatments with fewer long\-term side effects and, ultimately, cures.

**Rally is:** 

all about the kids!

mission driven and dedicated to investing in the best childhood cancer research

a grassroots organization built on a foundation of accountability and powered by volunteers

a fast\-paced learning environment

a close\-knit team with an “all hands\-on\-deck” attitude

open minded toward new, innovative ideas

serious about working hard to make a difference and about having fun while we’re doing it!

**Position Overview**

The Program \& Project Coordinator provides part\-time support across the organization's special projects and key initiatives including fundraising campaigns, programs, and special projects. This role is ideal for an organized, detail\-oriented self\-starter who wants hands\-on nonprofit project management experience and thrives in a collaborative, mission\-driven environment.

**Program \& Campaign Support**

* Assist with day\-to\-day coordination of Rally's fundraising campaigns and giving programs, including scheduling, communications, and tracking deadlines.
* Help create and maintain fundraising campaign pages, website updates, and campaign materials as needed.
* Support tracking of participation data, campaign outcomes, and reporting for active programs.
* Help maintain relationships with Rally’s partners

* Support volunteer coordination for Rally's signature events, including recruitment communications, scheduling, and maintaining volunteer rosters.

**Administrative \& Operational Support**

* Provide administrative and program management support for special projects and fundraising initiatives across the organization.
* Assist with database management.
* Help coordinate the creation of marketing and campaign materials.
* Support general shipping needs, including Rally merchandise.
* Provide backup support for Rally Good Meals.
* Assist and lead special projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* 1–2 years of experience in project coordination, nonprofit programs, administration, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable learning and using project management and campaign tools (e.g., Monday.com, GoFundMePro, Salesforce, Shopify), prior experience with these platforms is a plus, not a requirement.
* A collaborative, can\-do attitude and genuine enthusiasm for Rally's mission.
* Compassion and professionalism when engaging with families, hospital staff, volunteers, and donors.
* This position will report to Rally’s Senior Manager of Rally Families and Advocacy.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
