new_jobs.description:
Description:  



**Position Purpose**
====================


The Start\-Up \& Commissioning Project Coordinator is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, documentation, and field execution required to start, test, verify, and turn over HVAC and mechanical systems on assigned projects. Success in this role requires anticipating commissioning needs, coordinating technicians and trade partners, resolving deficiencies, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring systems are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements.


This position works closely with Project Managers, Project Executives, field leadership, controls, service/start\-up technicians, subcontractors, vendors, commissioning agents, engineers, and customers to remove obstacles and drive projects from construction completion through functional testing, owner acceptance, and turnover.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Develop and maintain a clear start\-up and commissioning plan that aligns with the project schedule and turnover milestones.
* Keep start\-up technicians, vendors, controls, and field teams coordinated so equipment and systems are ready when needed.
* Identify, track, and drive resolution of deficiencies that could delay testing, commissioning, or owner acceptance.
* Maintain complete, accurate start\-up, testing, commissioning, and turnover documentation.
* Build strong working relationships with project teams, commissioning agents, engineers, vendors, and customers while protecting Maxair’s interests.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Operational Leadership**
--------------------------

* Plan and coordinate equipment start\-up, pre\-functional checks, functional performance testing, and commissioning activities for assigned projects.
* Develop look\-ahead schedules and manpower plans for start\-up and commissioning activities in coordination with the project schedule.
* Confirm systems are ready for start\-up by coordinating completion of installation, power, controls, piping, ductwork, TAB prerequisites, and manufacturer requirements.
* Coordinate factory\-authorized representatives, vendors, subcontractors, controls providers, TAB contractors, and internal technicians.
* Track equipment status, deficiencies, punch\-list items, retesting, and completion dates; escalate issues before they affect milestones.
* Review plans, specifications, submittals, sequences of operation, and commissioning requirements to understand testing and turnover obligations.
* Maintain start\-up reports, checklists, commissioning forms, test records, deficiency logs, and project completion documentation.

**People Leadership**
---------------------

* Set clear daily and weekly priorities for start\-up and commissioning personnel and provide timely direction and feedback.
* Promote safe work practices, quality workmanship, accountability, and professional communication during testing and turnover activities.
* Support the development of technicians and field leaders by sharing system knowledge, lessons learned, and commissioning best practices.

**Customer \& Business Leadership**
-----------------------------------

* Communicate proactively with Project Managers, customers, commissioning agents, engineers, and field leaders regarding status, risks, deficiencies, and upcoming testing needs.
* Represent Maxair professionally during commissioning meetings, inspections, functional testing, and owner demonstrations.
* Coordinate warranty/start\-up issues and ensure open items are assigned, documented, and driven to closure.
* Support project closeout by helping ensure required training, O\&M information, test documentation, and commissioning records are complete.
* Make timely decisions that protect schedule, quality, customer relationships, and project profitability.

  

Requirements:
**Qualifications**
==================

* Strong commercial HVAC/mechanical systems experience, including equipment start\-up, controls, and system operation.
* Working knowledge of HVAC equipment, hydronic systems, air systems, controls sequences, and commissioning processes.
* Ability to read construction drawings, specifications, submittals, control diagrams, and sequences of operation.
* Strong planning, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple trades, vendors, technicians, and project stakeholders under changing field conditions.
* OSHA 30 Certification and valid driver’s license required based on company standards.
* Proficiency with Excel, Word, Outlook, project management/job cost software, and electronic commissioning documentation.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================


Successful Start\-Up \& Commissioning Project Coordinators consistently plan ahead, communicate clearly, hold themselves and others accountable, collaborate across departments and trades, make sound decisions under changing conditions, and build trust through reliable follow\-through. They take ownership of system readiness and turnover, surface problems early, and drive issues to closure while reflecting Maxair’s Core Values every day.

Description:
**U.S. Soccer Overview**


The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good.


We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S.

  

U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision\-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results.

**Soccer Forward Overview**


Soccer Forward is U.S. Soccer’s social impact and legacy initiative, created to harness the power of soccer to improve lives and strengthen communities across the country. Launched in the lead\-up to the 2026 FIFA Men’s World Cup, Soccer Forward is focused on ensuring the impact of this moment extends well beyond the tournament by creating greater access and opportunity to experience, play and participate in the game.


Through programs, partnerships and community\-based activations, Soccer Forward brings together organizations from across the soccer ecosystem, U.S. Soccer partners and donors, and national and local community organizations to create meaningful and lasting impact. By connecting U.S. Soccer’s reach and resources with organizations already doing important work in communities, Soccer Forward helps expand access to the game, strengthen the people and places that make soccer possible, and use the sport as a vehicle for positive change.


The Soccer Forward team develops and delivers thoughtful social impact strategies, programs and events that bring Soccer Forward’s priorities to life in communities across the country. Through community\-based activations, key U.S. Soccer moments and partner\-supported events, the team creates meaningful opportunities to expand access to the game, increase participation and strengthen communities. The team works closely with U.S. Soccer’s sponsors, media partners and donors to integrate their priorities into this work in authentic and impactful ways, while building and managing relationships with community organizations, U.S. Soccer members and other key stakeholders across the soccer ecosystem.

**Position Description**


The Research Coordinator will support the delivery of key research initiatives led by the Kang Women’s Institute, with a focus on improving female health, performance, and participation in soccer.


Working with researchers, industry partners, practitioners and governing bodies, this role will help ensure the successful execution of the Kang Women’s Institute’s research agenda. The Research Coordinator will help with the management of current research activities, support screening processes, and identify new research collaborations and partnerships.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Support the creation and ongoing management of a research consortium.
* Organize quarterly consortium meetings, other events and conferences, including scheduling, agenda development, meeting logistics and follow\-up actions events and conferences.
* Support with communication to consortium members including providing updates, meeting notes, and summary reports.
* Collaborate with the KWI team to coordinate and support research initiatives, ensuring deadlines are met, and clear communication is maintained.
* Support with the management and screening of inbound research requests using a prioritization process.
* Support with the identification of potential research partners including institutes, governing bodies, and industry.
* Facilitate collaboration between researchers, practitioners, governing bodies, and industry partners.
* Support with the screening of papers and projects to expand internal education knowledge base and work closely with the education team to provide insights to inform future education/curriculum development.
* Support with protocol design, IRB processes, participant recruitment, timelines and associated administration.
* Support the synthesis and communication of research findings through reports, presentations, and ecosystem\-facing content.
* Support the development of a centralized women's sport science data repository.
* Manage internal and external reporting processes to ensure key stakeholders are updated on research progress.


Requirements:
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in a relevant field (e.g. sports science, physiology, public health, or related discipline) or equivalent advanced research experience
* 2\+ years of experience in research, applied sport science, or related fields
* 2\+ years of experience managing research projects or partnerships across multiple stakeholders
* Demonstrable understanding of research design, data collection, and applied translation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex findings into clear outputs
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and manage multiple workstreams simultaneously

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience working in female athlete health and performance
* Experience working in research environments
* A passion for advancing research that improves participation and performance in soccer
* A Master's degree in a relevant field

You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to your success. Join us and help shape what’s next!

* Utilize smart, targeted questions to speak knowledgeably with decision makers such as VPs, Directors and C\-suite personnel

* Conduct territory development best practices with email, phone and chat using sales enablement tools to connect with new prospects and current customers

* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills, presentations skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives to engage and influence executive\-level decision makers

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* On\-Target Earnings of $70,000 per year. The starting pay for this role is $24\.04 per hour and the target variable pay for this role is $20,000\. Target variable pay is based on individual achievement factors and is not guaranteed. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. Location: Atlanta, GA, United States

**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

new_jobs.description:
**About You:**Are you extremely organized? Do you take a proactive approach to solving problems? Do you act with integrity and hold yourself to the highest standard? If the answer is, "Yes!" then we have an opportunity that will excite you. Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.  



ARCO/Murray National Construction is currently looking for a detail\-oriented, self\-reliant Project Coordinator to join our team. At ARCO, you'll have the opportunity to improve project performance, set up processes and drive your own success from day one!  


**A Day in the Life:*** Typing/preparing various items such as letters, bid instructions, meeting minutes, weekly updates, memos, proposals, outline specifications, timesheets, and expense reports
* Assist Project Managers with Proposals by typing up proposal letters, outline specifications, manage the work/design schedule and assemble proposal books in a timely manner as per Project Manager
* Maintain various lists for Project Managers including job list for each region, subcontract tracking list, filing and vacation lists
* Prepare various forms as directed by Projects Managers (Subcontracts, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, AGC Agreements, Professional Service Agreements, and transmittals)
* Point person for proposal and capabilities packages. This includes putting together proposal covers, tabs, company information, sell sheets and then assembling once provided with rest of the materials by Project Manager
* Preparation for meetings and trainings including scheduling, preparing handouts, and coordinating lunches
* Book all travel when necessary
* Answer incoming phone calls and coordinate communication with vendors and customers in the event of a Project Manager's absence
* Maintain all files, including preparing new files and sending old files off site

  


**Necessary Qualifications:*** 3\-10 years of related experience, construction administration experience considered a plus
* Excellent computer skills, must be proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel
* Must be extremely organized, self\-reliant, proactive, and detail\-oriented

  


**What We Can Offer You:**We are dedicated to the well\-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world.


* Industry\-leading performance\-based bonus program
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Traditional and Roth 401k
* Tuition reimbursement for associates
* Scholarship for associates' children up to $28,000 per child
* 1\-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel
* 1\-week paid volunteer leave each year
* 100% charitable match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* Paid parental leave


Typical base compensation for the Project Coordinator role is between $60,000 and $80,000\. Candidates with extensive experience may exceed this range. In addition to base salary, the role is eligible to receive discretionary bonus compensation based on individual and company.  



At ARCO, our first core value is to treat people fairly and do the right thing. We are committed to building and sustaining a culture that supports diversity and inclusion. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.



From recruiting, training, and hiring practices to selecting our subcontractors, we understand that diversity of all those involved in the construction process enhances our ability to deliver the best solutions to our customers. We hire the best and the brightest from across the country – constructing a team of experts in architecture, design, engineering, project management, and business services.

  


*\#LI\-AM2 \#LI\-Onsite* **MAKE YOUR MOVE**



We are proud to be one of the fastest\-growing, privately\-owned companies in America, celebrating over 30 years of experience as design\-build experts. We have completed over 7,500 design\-build projects nationwide. We ranked \#9 on ENR's Design\-Build Firms list and \#34 on ENR's Top 400 Contractors list of 2026\. Most importantly, our clients like us, trust us, and want to do business with us. We are looking for people with the same enthusiasm, passion, and respect for the hard work that brought us to where we are today. Are you a person who can make a difference at ARCO? If the answer is "Yes!" we look forward to meeting you.


*ARCO does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies without pre\-approval from ARCO's Human Resources team. Pre\-approval is required before any external candidate can be submitted. ARCO will not be responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes and for candidates who are sent directly to our hiring managers. Agencies must have a fully executed vendor agreement in place as well as written approval to submit candidates from an ARCO TA Manager for a specific position before submitting candidates.*

new_jobs.title: Field Marketing & Events Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Head of Marketing

**Location:** Chicago, New York City, San Diego, or Salt Lake City; hybrid

**Hours:** Full time

**Compensation:** $120,00\-$150,000

**About this role**
-------------------


ReflexAI’s **Field Marketing \& Events Manager** shapes and executes ReflexAI's events program with precision and creative excellence across conferences, tradeshows, executive forums, hosted experiences, and virtual events. The role coordinates closely with sales, customer success, product marketing, demand generation, design, and external vendors to ensure every event is executed on time, on brand, and on brief. You’ll bring genuine creative instinct to the experience layer: how the brand shows up, how guests move through the experience, the moments that create connection, the swag, the venue details, the run\-of\-show moments that make an event feel considered rather than assembled. You'll represent ReflexAI on\-site with prospects and customers, understanding who our executive audience is and what they care about, and speaking to our work with credibility.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Partner with the Head of Marketing to translate ReflexAI's positioning and story into field and event experiences, ensuring every touchpoint feels distinct to our brand, wherever we show up.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery for all event types: tradeshows, executive forums, hosted dinners, online events and conference activations, including vendor management (booth design/production, shipping, A/V, venues, catering, swag).
* Own webinar and virtual event production end\-to\-end: platform setup, registration and reminder flows, speaker prep and tech run\-throughs, day\-of moderation support, and post\-event asset delivery (recording, follow\-up email)
* Turn event briefs into clear plans that align our team on audience, desired outcomes, experience approach, and operational needs with clear owners, deadlines, and dependencies. Maintain the templates and standards that keep quality consistent as the program scales.
* Work with product marketing and customer success to recruit customers for co\-speaking opportunities and coordinate their full participation (travel, run\-of\-show, prep calls, on\-site experience), ensuring they're engaged intentionally.
* Manage gifting and direct mail programs: ABM outreach coordinated with sales and growth, and thank\-you gifts for customers, speakers, and case study contributors — owning vendor selection, curation, and fulfillment logistics so every gift lands with thoughtful timing.
* Proactively coordinate with sales, product marketing, demand generation, customer success, and design: briefing sales before every event, aligning with demand gen on outreach, keeping stakeholders updated with structured communication, flagging risks early, and ensuring post\-event follow\-up happens on schedule. Close the loop with clean recaps (actuals vs. plan) and patterns that inform future planning.

**Requirements for a great fit**
--------------------------------

* 5\+ years of event marketing or field marketing experience in B2B SaaS
* A track record of exceptional execution. You anticipate details others miss, build systems that prevent surprises, and stay composed and resourceful when plans change.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross\-functionally in a remote environment, managing timelines and stakeholder accountability without a shared office to fall back on
* Experience managing both tradeshows *and* high\-touch, intimate formats (hosted dinners, roundtables, or executive forums).
* Experience running webinars or virtual events, including platform management and registration/promotion coordination
* A genuine creative sensibility for events. You have opinions about what makes an experience memorable and you can articulate them
* Comfortable and confident representing a brand on\-site with prospects and customers
* Strong written communication: clear enough to brief a vendor, direct enough to flag a risk to your manager
* Willingness and ability to travel multiple times per year

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Some of the most rewarding work you will ever do, solving real problems and helping people be the best versions of themselves
* Working alongside a team that is exceptionally smart and ambitious, but also humble and kind
* Generous retirement, equity, healthcare, and PTO policies

new_jobs.description:
**Community/Behavioral Health Outreach Coordinator**

**Organization Overview**

American Indian Health Service of Chicago, Inc. (AIHSC) is a federally qualified health center (FQHC) dedicated to providing comprehensive primary care, behavioral health services, case management, and community health education to the Native American community and other underserved populations of Chicago. Our mission is to improve the health and wellness of our community through accessible, high\-quality, and culturally appropriate health care services.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, particularly those with ties to Native American communities.

**Position Overview**

The Outreach Coordinator will support the Behavioral Health team by increasing awareness of available services; providing information and linkage to Behavioral Health services; developing educational and outreach materials; coordinating prevention activities; and strengthening relationships with community members. This role supports clinical staff by helping community members understand available services and connect to appropriate care, while allowing clinical staff to focus on direct patient care. The Outreach Coordinator does not schedule Behavioral Health appointments or make clinical referrals.

The Outreach Coordinator will also facilitate or co\-facilitate non\-clinical psycho\-educational, wellness, and culturally based support groups that promote prevention, resilience, healing, and community connection. AIHSC seeks a dependable, mission\-driven professional who is interested in a long\-term role and committed to building sustained, trusting relationships with community members, patients, partners, and colleagues.

**Scope of Services**

The Outreach Coordinator may provide non\-clinical psycho\-education, wellness support, culturally based support groups, community\-resource information, prevention education, and linkage to care. This position does not provide psychotherapy, clinical counseling, diagnosis, clinical assessment, or independent crisis intervention. When an individual has urgent behavioral health, safety, or crisis needs, the Outreach Coordinator will immediately notify and connect the individual with an appropriately qualified Behavioral Health clinician, supervisor, crisis service, emergency service, or other designated resource in accordance with AIHSC policy.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Community Outreach**

· Represent the Behavioral Health Department at community events, health fairs, powwows, schools, partner agencies, and outreach activities.

· Build trusting relationships with community members through consistent presence and engagement.

· Provide education regarding behavioral health, Substance Use Recovery Services (SURS), crisis resources, suicide prevention, and available community support.

· Conduct outreach activities designed to reduce stigma surrounding behavioral health services.

· Promote behavioral\-health groups, workshops, and community events.

· Conduct outreach to individuals who may benefit from behavioral\-health services and provide information and linkage to appropriate care.

**Groups, Prevention, and Community Programming**

· Facilitate or co\-facilitate non\-clinical psycho\-educational groups focused on wellness, stress management, coping skills, resiliency, healthy relationships, parenting, substance\-use prevention, and life skills.

· Coordinate with the Cultural Committee to support culturally responsive groups that promote healing, cultural identity, community connectedness, and traditional wellness practices.

· Assist Behavioral Health clinicians with community\-based workshops, educational presentations, and prevention programming.

· Monitor and document group attendance through sign\-in sheets, preregistration records, or other approved tracking methods.

**Educational Materials and Community Awareness**

· Assist with the development and distribution of culturally responsive flyers, brochures, and educational handouts.

· Coordinate dissemination of outreach and prevention materials throughout the community.

· Collaborate with the Behavioral Health team to identify educational topics based on emerging community needs and trends.

· Maintain outreach supplies, educational resources, and promotional materials.

**Collaboration, Documentation, and Quality Support**

· Attend Behavioral Health team meetings and assist with planning outreach, prevention, group, and community\-engagement activities.

· Collaborate with Behavioral Health clinicians, community partners, the Cultural Committee, and other AIHSC departments to support coordinated services.

· Document outreach contacts, group attendance, community events, educational materials distributed, linkage\-to\-care activities, and outcomes in approved tracking tools, databases, and/or the EHR, as applicable.

· Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential records in accordance with AIHSC policies, HIPAA requirements, and grant or program reporting requirements.

· Assist with data collection, program evaluation, and reporting activities related to outreach, prevention, and community engagement.

**Education and Experience**

· Associate degree required in human services, behavioral health, social services, public health, community health, education, or a related field.

· An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience in behavioral health, community outreach, peer support, social services, prevention, or community engagement may be considered.

· Experience providing community outreach, behavioral\-health support, social services, community education, peer support, or related services is preferred.

· Experience facilitating educational groups, support groups, or community workshops is preferred.

· Experience working with American Indian/Alaska Native communities, urb
